soru_metni: For decades, scientists believed that adult brains were completely hardwired and unable to grow new connections. However, recent discoveries in neuroscience have shattered this myth. ______. This phenomenon, known as neuroplasticity, means that the brain can continuously adapt, learn, and recover from injuries throughout a person's life.
secenekler: Most brain development occurs during the first three years of childhood.
It turns out that the human brain remains remarkably flexible and capable of reorganizing itself.
Computers are still far superior to human brains in terms of raw processing speed.
Unfortunately, brain cells begin to die rapidly after a person reaches the age of thirty.
Neurologists recommend taking daily vitamin supplements to boost memory retention.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce beynin yeni bağlar kuramadığı yönündeki eski inanışın yıkıldığından bahsedilmektedir. Boşluktan hemen sonra gelen "neuroplasticity" (nöroplastisite) kavramı ve beynin sürekli uyum sağlayabilmesi ifadesi, boşluğa beynin esnek ve kendini yeniden organize edebilir yapısını anlatan B seçeneğinin gelmesini gerektirir.

soru_metni: The rise of e-commerce has fundamentally transformed the retail sector over the last decade. Traditional brick-and-mortar stores are struggling to compete with online platforms. ______. In response, many physical retailers are trying to survive by offering unique in-store experiences that cannot be replicated online.
secenekler: Online shopping has become extremely popular due to its convenience and lower prices.
Many consumers still prefer to touch and feel a product before making a purchase.
E-commerce companies are investing heavily in automated drone delivery networks.
The cost of renting commercial property in city centers has dropped significantly.
Traditional shopping malls are being converted into modern residential apartments.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde e-ticaretin yükselişinden ve fiziksel mağazaların çevrimiçi platformlarla rekabet etmekte zorlandığından bahsedilmektedir. Boşluğa, bu zorluğun temel sebebini ve e-ticaretin neden popüler olduğunu açıklayan A seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Regular physical exercise is well-known for its physical benefits, such as cardiovascular health and weight management. However, its positive effects on mental health are equally significant. ______. This biological response explains why many people experience a burst of energy and happiness after a workout.
secenekler: Most personal trainers recommend working out at least three times a week.
When you exercise, your brain releases chemicals like endorphins that reduce stress and elevate mood.
Gym memberships have become much more expensive due to rising inflation rates.
Some people find it extremely difficult to stick to a structured workout routine.
Yoga and meditation are also excellent practices for improving mental clarity.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra "This biological response" (Bu biyolojik tepki) ifadesiyle bir biyolojik mekanizmaya atıfta bulunulmaktadır. B seçeneğinde egzersiz sırasında beynin endorfin salgılamasından ve bunun stresi azaltıp ruh halini iyileştirmesinden bahsedilerek bu biyolojik tepki tam olarak açıklanmıştır.

soru_metni: Deep-sea exploration is one of the most challenging frontiers in modern science. The extreme pressure, freezing temperatures, and total darkness make it incredibly hostile to humans. ______. These unmanned vehicles are equipped with cameras and sensors to gather data from the ocean floor safely.
secenekler: Many marine biologists are highly interested in studying the habits of deep-sea sharks.
To overcome these harsh conditions, researchers heavily rely on advanced robotic submarines.
Submarine cables are essential for transmitting internet data across different continents.
The depths of the ocean contain vast amounts of untapped mineral and energy resources.
Most ordinary citizens do not realize how expensive oceanography projects actually are.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde derin denizlerin insanlar için aşırı zorlu ve düşmanca koşullarından (basınç, karanlık) bahsedilmektedir. Boşluktan hemen sonra gelen "These unmanned vehicles" (Bu insansız araçlar) ifadesini hazırlayan ve bu zorlu koşulların robotik denizaltılarla aşıldığını belirten B seçeneği akışı mükemmel şekilde tamamlar.

soru_metni: The transition to electric vehicles (EVs) is key to reducing global carbon emissions from transportation. Governments worldwide are offering subsidies to encourage drivers to switch. ______. Until charging times are reduced and stations become as common as petrol pumps, many consumers will hesitate to buy them.
secenekler: EV batteries require rare earth minerals like lithium and cobalt to manufacture.
However, the lack of widespread charging infrastructure remains a major obstacle.
Most modern electric cars have a driving range of over three hundred miles.
Public transportation systems are also being upgraded with electric buses.
Driving an electric vehicle is much quieter and smoother than a petrol car.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra şarj süreleri kısaltılana ve istasyonlar yaygınlaşana kadar tüketicilerin kararsız kalacağından bahsedilmektedir. Bu duruma "However" (Ancak) geçişiyle bağlanan ve altyapı eksikliğini büyük bir engel olarak tanımlayan B seçeneği boşluk için en uygun ifadedir.

soru_metni: Linguists have long debated the extent to which our native language shapes our perception of reality. Some argue that language places strict limits on how we categorize the world. ______. They suggest that while language influences our thought patterns, it does not completely determine them.
secenekler: Learning a second language during adulthood is generally much harder than in childhood.
However, a more moderate view has gained popularity in recent decades.
Most indigenous languages are rapidly disappearing due to globalization.
English has become the undisputed global language of business and science.
Grammar rules vary significantly across different language families worldwide.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce dilin dünyayı algılama biçimimizi tamamen sınırladığı yönündeki uç/keskin bir görüşten bahsedilmiştir. Boşluktan sonra ise "They suggest that..." diyerek daha yumuşak/ılımlı bir yaklaşım sunulduğu için, boşluğa bu iki durum arasında köprü kuran "daha ılımlı bir görüşün popülerlik kazandığını" belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: For centuries, the city of Venice has successfully captured the imagination of travelers with its unique canals and historic architecture. ______. Rising sea levels, combined with the gradual sinking of the city's foundations, pose an existential threat. Scientists and engineers are working urgently on barrier systems to protect it from catastrophic high tides.
secenekler: Many tourists visit the city during the annual carnival in February.
However, this beautiful lagoon city is currently facing a severe environmental crisis.
Gondolas are the traditional and most famous mode of transport in Venice.
The city was once a powerful maritime republic and trade hub in the Mediterranean.
Building a house on water requires extremely advanced engineering skills.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra Venedik'in karşı karşıya olduğu yükselen deniz seviyeleri, batma tehlikesi ve yok olma tehdidi (existential threat) detaylandırılmaktadır. Girişteki olumlu tasvirden bu çevresel tehditlere geçişi sağlayan B seçeneği ("Ancak bu güzel şehir ciddi bir çevre kriziyle karşı karşıya") boşluğu mükemmel doldurur.

soru_metni: In the business world, emotional intelligence (EQ) is increasingly recognized as a key trait of successful leaders. While technical skills and IQ are important, they are no longer sufficient on their own. ______. They are better equipped to motivate employees, handle workplace stress, and build strong, collaborative teams.
secenekler: Many companies still rely on standardized IQ tests during their hiring processes.
Leaders with high EQ can understand and manage both their own emotions and those of others.
The average salary of a chief executive officer has risen dramatically recently.
Some employees prefer working independently rather than in collaborative teams.
Technical training programs are essential for keeping staff updated on new software.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonraki "They" (Onlar) zamiri, EQ seviyesi yüksek liderlere atıfta bulunmaktadır. EQ'su yüksek liderlerin kendi ve başkalarının duygularını anlayıp yönetebildiğini belirten B seçeneği, sonraki cümlenin öznesini ve anlam akışını mükemmel şekilde destekler.

soru_metni: Urban green spaces, such as parks and community gardens, are vital for the health of city residents. They provide areas for physical activity, relaxation, and social interaction. ______. This temperature reduction is crucial for mitigating the 'urban heat island' effect in concrete-heavy areas.
secenekler: Most municipal councils do not allocate enough budget to maintain public parks.
Additionally, trees and plants in these spaces help cool the air through evaporation.
Many people prefer living in suburban areas with large private gardens instead.
Air pollution is a major contributor to respiratory diseases in large megacities.
Public parks often attract tourists, boosting the local economy of the city.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra gelen "This temperature reduction" (Bu sıcaklık düşüşü) ifadesi, boşluğa havanın soğutulmasıyla ilgili bir cümlenin gelmesini gerektirir. B seçeneğinde ağaçların ve bitkilerin buharlaşma yoluyla havayı soğutmaya yardımcı olduğu belirtilerek bu anlam bağı eksiksiz kurulmuştur.

soru_metni: The concept of 'mindfulness' has gained massive popularity in Western countries as a tool for stress reduction. Originally derived from ancient Buddhist meditation practices, it involves focusing on the present moment without judgment. ______. Scientific studies show that regular practice can actually alter brain structures associated with anxiety and emotional regulation.
secenekler: Meditation can be practiced anywhere, from a quiet bedroom to a busy office desk.
Its benefits are not just spiritual; they are increasingly backed by clinical research.
Many companies now offer free mindfulness classes to their employees during breaks.
Ancient philosophy has always been highly interested in the nature of human happiness.
Some critics argue that mindfulness has been commercialized as a trendy wellness product.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonraki cümle "Scientific studies show..." (Bilimsel çalışmalar gösteriyor ki...) diye başlayarak kavramın klinik ve bilimsel dayanaklarına geçiş yapmaktadır. Boşluğa, bu geçişi sağlayan ve faydaların sadece ruhsal değil klinik araştırmalarla da desteklendiğini belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Fossil fuels have powered human civilization since the Industrial Revolution. However, their combustion is the primary driver of global climate change. ______. Wind, solar, and geothermal power offer cleaner alternatives that can meet our energy demands without destroying the atmosphere.
secenekler: Oil-producing nations are currently enjoying massive economic profits.
Therefore, transitioning to renewable energy sources has become an urgent necessity.
The cost of installing solar panels on residential roofs is still quite high.
Coal mining is one of the most dangerous and unhealthy occupations in the world.
Fossil fuel reserves are expected to be completely depleted within the next century.
aciklama: Fosil yakıtların iklim değişikliğinin temel nedeni olduğunun belirtilmesinden sonra, rüzgar ve güneş gibi temiz alternatiflerin bu ihtiyacı karşılayabileceği söylenmiştir. Bu durum geçişi sağlayan "Therefore" (Bu nedenle) ifadesiyle yenilenebilir enerjiye yönelmenin aciliyetini vurgulayan B seçeneğini gerektirir.

soru_metni: In the culinary world, spices have historically been valued not just for flavor, but for their preservative qualities. Before modern refrigeration, meat and dairy spoiled quickly. ______. This practice was especially common in hot tropical climates, where bacteria grew at an alarming rate.
secenekler: Spices like pepper and cinnamon were once as valuable as gold in Europe.
Adding certain antimicrobial spices helped slow down the spoilage process significantly.
Most modern chefs prefer using fresh herbs rather than dried spices in their dishes.
Spices were primarily transported along the famous Silk Road trade route.
The government has recently placed strict regulations on food additives and chemicals.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde yiyeceklerin hızlı bozulduğundan söz edilmektedir. Boşluğa, antimikrobiyal baharatların eklenmesinin bozulma sürecini (spoilage process) yavaşlattığını söyleyen ve bir sonraki cümledeki "This practice" (Bu uygulama) ifadesine referans veren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Mars Perseverance rover has been sending back extraordinary images and data from the red planet. Its primary mission is to search for signs of ancient microbial life. ______. If scientists find organic molecules in these clay minerals, it could prove that Mars was once habitable billions of years ago.
secenekler: Mars has two small moons, Phobos and Deimos, which are likely captured asteroids.
To do this, it is currently exploring the Jezero Crater, a dried-up ancient lake bed.
Sending humans to Mars presents severe technological and physiological challenges.
The gravity on Mars is only about thirty-eight percent of the gravity on Earth.
NASA plans to launch a manned mission to the red planet sometime in the late 2030s.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde aracın birincil görevinin antik yaşam izleri aramak olduğu söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, "To do this" (Bunu yapmak için) ifadesiyle başlayan ve aracın şu an kurumuş bir göl yatağını (ancient lake bed) araştırdığını belirterek görevin detayını veren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Sleep plays a critical role in brain function and systemic physical health. During deep sleep, the body repairs tissues, synthesizes hormones, and consolidates memories. ______. Chronic sleep deprivation, on the other hand, is linked to heart disease, obesity, and cognitive decline.
secenekler: Most teenagers require at least nine hours of sleep every night to function fully.
In short, getting sufficient quality sleep is essential for long-term well-being.
Coffee and other caffeinated beverages can seriously disrupt your sleep cycle.
Some people find that using a white noise machine helps them fall asleep faster.
Dreaming occurs primarily during the rapid eye movement (REM) phase of sleep.
aciklama: Derin uykunun faydalarından bahsedildikten sonra boşluktan sonra "on the other hand" (diğer yandan) denilerek uykusuzluğun zararlarına geçilmiştir. Boşluğa, uykunun genel önemini özetleyen "In short..." (Kısacası...) ifadesiyle başlayan B seçeneği yerleşmelidir.

soru_metni: The Great Wall of China is not a single continuous wall, but a vast network of defensive fortifications. Built over several dynasties, its primary purpose was protection against nomadic invasions from the north. ______. It served as a secure corridor for transporting goods, soldiers, and communication signals across vast mountain ranges.
secenekler: The wall is constructed primarily of rammed earth, stone, and brick materials.
However, it also functioned as an important trade and transport infrastructure.
Many tourists walk along the restored sections of the wall near Beijing every year.
The construction of the wall required the labor of millions of peasants and soldiers.
Historically, the wall was not always successful in stopping determined invaders.
aciklama: Boşluktan hemen sonra duvarın eşyaları, askerleri ve sinyalleri taşımak için güvenli bir koridor görevi gördüğü anlatılmaktadır. "However" (Ancak) geçişiyle duvarın aynı zamanda bir ticaret ve ulaşım altyapısı olduğunu belirten B seçeneği akışı mükemmel bağlar.

soru_metni: Artificial intelligence (AI) has made dramatic advancements in the field of creative arts. Algorithms can now generate high-quality paintings, write poetry, and even compose symposia. ______. Critics argue that true art requires subjective human experience, emotion, and consciousness, which machines simply do not possess.
secenekler: Many digital artists are already using AI tools to brainstorm visual concepts quickly.
However, this technological development has sparked a intense philosophical debate.
AI music generators can analyze millions of pop songs to create a perfect melody.
Some software developers believe that AI will soon surpass human intelligence entirely.
The market value of AI-generated art pieces has risen significantly in auctions.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra sanat eleştirmenlerinin yapay zekanın gerçek sanatsal duygudan ve bilinçten yoksun olduğu yönündeki karşı çıkışları (Critics argue...) ele alınmıştır. Boşluğa, bu tartışmayı başlatan "Ancak bu teknolojik gelişme yoğun bir felsefi tartışma başlattı" diyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Galapagos Islands are famous for their unique biodiversity, which inspired Charles Darwin's theory of evolution. Because of their extreme isolation, many species found there exist nowhere else on Earth. ______. Invasive species introduced by human settlers, combined with rising tourism, are threatening these fragile ecosystems.
secenekler: Darwin visited the islands in eighteen thirty-five aboard the HMS Beagle ship.
Unfortunately, this unique biological heritage is currently under severe threat.
Giant tortoises are the most famous and longest-living residents of the islands.
The islands are located in the Pacific Ocean, about six hundred miles off Ecuador.
Volcanic activity continuously shapes the geography and landscapes of the archipelago.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde adaların eşsiz biyolojik çeşitliliğinden övgüyle bahsedilirken, boşluk sonrasında insan eliyle getirilen istilacı türlerin ve turizmin bu hassas ekosistemi tehdit ettiği (threatening...) anlatılmaktadır. Bu olumsuz gidişatı "Unfortunately" (Maalesef) diyerek duyuran B seçeneği akışa uygundur.

soru_metni: In educational psychology, 'active learning' is widely considered far more effective than passive listening. Instead of just sitting and listening to a lecture, students engage in discussions, problem-solving, and hands-on activities. ______. This cognitive engagement helps solidify new information and improves long-term recall.
secenekler: Traditional classroom lectures are still the most common method in public universities.
This approach forces the brain to process and organize information actively.
Most high schools do not have the necessary funding to build modern laboratories.
Some students prefer studying alone in a quiet room rather than in groups.
Online courses have made education much more accessible for working adults globally.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra "This cognitive engagement" (Bu bilişsel katılım) ifadesi kullanılmıştır. B seçeneğinde yer alan "Bu yaklaşım beyni bilgiyi aktif işlemeye zorlar" ifadesi, bu bilişsel katılımı açıklayarak boşluğu doğal biçimde tamamlar.

soru_metni: Throughout history, honey has been valued not only as a sweet food but also as a powerful medicinal substance. Its low moisture content and high acidity make it highly inhospitable to bacteria. ______. For this reason, ancient civilizations frequently used it to treat wounds, burns, and skin infections.
secenekler: Beekeeping was an highly respected occupation in ancient Egypt and Greece.
In fact, honey can remain preserved for thousands of years without spoiling.
Consequently, it acts as a natural antiseptic that prevents bacterial growth.
Most modern doctors recommend against giving honey to infants under one year old.
Honey contains various healthy antioxidants and organic compounds.
aciklama: Balın nemsiz ve asidik yapısının bakterilerin üremesini engellediği belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu durumun bir sonucu olarak "Consequently, it acts as a natural antiseptic..." (Sonuç olarak, bakteri gelişimini önleyen doğal bir antiseptik görevi görür) diyen C seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The concept of 'slow fashion' has emerged as a response to the environmental damage caused by the fast-fashion industry. It encourages consumers to buy fewer, higher-quality clothes that are designed to last. ______. By prioritizing quality over quantity, it aims to reduce the massive textile waste currently filling global landfills.
secenekler: Fast-fashion brands can produce and distribute new clothing styles in just two weeks.
Additionally, slow fashion promotes fair wages and ethical working conditions for factory workers.
Most synthetic clothing fibers, like polyester, take hundreds of years to decompose.
Furthermore, it emphasizes sustainable production methods and organic materials.
Many consumers are willing to pay higher prices for designer clothing brands.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında "kaliteyi niceliğe tercih ederek, tekstil atıklarını azaltmayı hedeflediğinden" bahsedilmektedir. Boşluğa, yavaş modanın çevre koruma boyutuna "Furthermore" (Dahası) eklemesiyle devam eden, sürdürülebilir üretim yöntemleri ve organik materyalleri vurgulayan D seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The printing press, invented by Johannes Gutenberg in the fifteenth century, is arguably the most important invention of the second millennium. Before its creation, books had to be copied by hand, making them incredibly rare and expensive. ______. This rapid dissemination of information fueled the Scientific Revolution and the Renaissance.
secenekler: Gutenberg's first major printed book was a beautifully illustrated Latin Bible.
The printing press allowed thousands of copies of a book to be produced in weeks.
Most ordinary citizens in medieval Europe were completely illiterate and could not read.
Paper production technology had to be imported from China before printing could begin.
Many monastic scribes lost their jobs due to the rapid automation of book copying.
aciklama: Kitapların eskiden elle kopyalandığı ve pahalı olduğu, boşluk sonrasında ise bilginin hızlı yayılmasının (rapid dissemination of information) dünyayı değiştirdiği söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, matbaanın kitapların haftalar içinde binlerce adet basılabilmesini sağladığını söyleyerek bu hızlı yayılımın mekanizmasını anlatan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Micro-plastics have become one of the most pervasive environmental pollutants of our time. These tiny plastic particles, measuring less than five millimeters, are now found everywhere, from the deepest ocean trenches to Arctic snow. ______. They are ingested by marine life and gradually make their way up the food chain, eventually reaching human diets.
secenekler: Most plastic waste in the oceans comes from single-use packaging and bags.
Unfortunately, their small size makes them incredibly easy for organisms to consume.
Scientists are currently developing biodegradable plastics made from cornstarch.
The physical filtration of micro-plastics from municipal tap water is extremely difficult.
Many countries have recently implemented bans on plastic microbeads in cosmetics.
aciklama: Boşluktan hemen sonra gelen "They are ingested by marine life..." (Deniz canlıları tarafından yutulurlar...) ifadesi, boşluktaki cümlenin küçük boyutları nedeniyle mikroplastiklerin organizmalar tarafından tüketilmesinin çok kolay olduğunu belirten B seçeneğiyle doğrudan bağlantılı olmasını gerektirir.

soru_metni: The human gut microbiome consists of trillions of microorganisms that play a vital role in digestion and physical health. Recent research suggests that these bacteria also communicate directly with the brain through the vagus nerve. ______. For instance, an imbalance in gut bacteria has been linked to increased levels of anxiety and depression.
secenekler: Doctors recommend eating fermented foods like yogurt to support gut health.
This 'gut-brain axis' means that our digestive health can directly affect our mental state.
Antibiotics can unfortunately destroy beneficial bacteria along with harmful pathogens.
The digestive system is responsible for absorbing essential nutrients from our food.
Most serotonin in the human body is actually produced inside the gastrointestinal tract.
aciklama: Bağırsaktaki bakterilerin vagus siniri yoluyla beyinle doğrudan iletişim kurduğundan bahsedilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu durumu "gut-brain axis" (bağırsak-beyin aksı) olarak tanımlayan ve sindirim sağlığının zihinsel durumu doğrudan etkileyebileceğini belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Great Fire of London in sixteen sixty-six was a catastrophic event that destroyed most of the city's medieval wooden buildings. Over seventy thousand residents were left homeless, and major landmarks like St. Paul's Cathedral were reduced to ashes. ______. Wood was banned, and buildings had to be constructed using brick and stone to prevent future disasters.
secenekler: The fire started in a bakery on Pudding Lane during a dry summer evening.
However, this tragedy provided a unique opportunity to rebuild the city with safer materials.
King Charles the Second actively supervised the relief efforts for the homeless victims.
Most insurance companies were established in London shortly after this massive disaster.
The rebuild plan designed by architect Christopher Wren was unfortunately rejected.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında gelecekteki felaketleri önlemek için ahşabın yasaklandığı, binaların tuğla ve taştan yapılması gerektiği belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu felaketin şehri daha güvenli malzemelerle (safer materials) yeniden inşa etmek için eşsiz bir fırsat sunduğunu söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The concept of 'gamification' involves applying game-design elements and mechanics to non-game contexts, such as education and business. By introducing points, badges, and leaderboards, it aims to increase user engagement and motivation. ______. When a task feels like a game, people are naturally more willing to invest time and effort into completing it.
secenekler: Many mobile applications use gamification to encourage users to exercise daily.
This approach leverages the human desire for competition, achievement, and reward.
Some critics argue that badges and leaderboards only offer superficial motivation.
Video games are one of the most profitable entertainment industries in the world today.
Educators have been using games in classrooms since the early twentieth century.
aciklama: Oyunlaştırma mekaniklerinin (puan, rozet) kullanıcı katılımını nasıl artırdığı anlatılmıştır. Boşluğa, bu yaklaşımın rekabet, başarı ve ödül gibi insani arzuları tetiklediğini söyleyen B seçeneği gelmeli ve devamında gelen oyun hissiyle süreklilik sağlamalıdır.

soru_metni: The desert biome is characterized by extremely low rainfall and temperature extremes. To survive in these harsh conditions, desert plants have evolved remarkable adaptations. ______. Cacti, for instance, have thick, waxy skin to prevent water loss and sharp spines to protect themselves from thirsty animals.
secenekler: Most desert animals are nocturnal and only active during the cooler night hours.
The primary strategy for these plants is the efficient storage and conservation of water.
Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world, stretching across North Africa.
Some desert seeds can remain dormant in the dry soil for several years before rain.
Oases are crucial water sources that support lush vegetation in arid regions.
aciklama: Çöl bitkilerinin hayatta kalmak için geliştirdiği adaptasyonlardan (remarkable adaptations) söz edilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu bitkilerin temel hayatta kalma stratejisinin suyun verimli depolanması ve korunması (conservation of water) olduğunu söyleyen ve devamindeki kaktüs örneğiyle (su kaybını önleme) doğrudan uyum sağlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In history, the Silk Road was a network of trade routes connecting East Asia with the Mediterranean world. While silk was the primary commodity traded, it was not the only one. ______. Technologies like paper-making, gunpowder, and printing traveled from China to Europe, fundamentally changing human history.
secenekler: Many merchants faced extreme dangers from bandits and harsh mountain weather.
In addition to physical goods, the routes allowed for a massive exchange of ideas and technologies.
The Silk Road trade declined significantly after the fall of the Mongol Empire.
Spices, jade, and glassware were also highly popular goods among ancient traders.
Marco Polo is perhaps the most famous European traveler to walk the Silk Road.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede kağıt yapımı, barut ve matbaa gibi teknolojilerin Çin'den Avrupa'ya seyahat ettiği (Technologies like paper-making... traveled...) belirtilmektedir. Boşluğa, fiziksel malların yanı sıra bu rotaların devasa bir fikir ve teknoloji alışverişine (exchange of ideas and technologies) izin verdiğini söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The human eye is an incredibly complex organ capable of adjusting to different lighting conditions. In bright environments, the pupil constricts to limit the amount of light entering. ______. This slow adaptation process explains why it takes several minutes to see clearly when entering a dark cinema.
secenekler: Color blindness is a genetic condition that affects the perception of red and green.
Conversely, in dim light, the pupil dilates to capture as much ambient light as possible.
The retina contains millions of photoreceptor cells known as rods and cones.
Most eye doctors recommend wearing sunglasses to protect the retina from UV rays.
Wearing corrective lenses can easily fix common vision problems like myopia.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde gözbebeğinin aydınlık ortamlardaki tepkisi (küçülmesi - constricts) anlatılmıştır. Boşluğa, "Conversely" (Aksine) geçişiyle başlayarak loş/karanlık ortamlardaki tepkiyi (büyümesi - dilates) anlatan ve devamindeki karanlık sinema örneğiyle örtüşen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In the modern digital economy, data has often been described as the 'new oil.' Just like oil, raw data is valuable, but only when it is refined and analyzed properly. ______. Advanced algorithms can identify hidden consumer habits, predict future market trends, and help companies make highly strategic decisions.
secenekler: Many internet companies collect massive amounts of user data through cookies.
This refining process is done through sophisticated data analytics and machine learning.
Unfortunately, data breaches and cyber-attacks are becoming much more common.
The storage of digital data in cloud servers requires immense amounts of electricity.
Most consumers are highly concerned about their online privacy and personal data safety.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde ham verinin ancak düzgün bir şekilde arıtıldığında ve analiz edildiğinde (refined and analyzed properly) değerli olduğundan söz edilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu arıtma işleminin (refining process) gelişmiş veri analitiği ve makine öğrenimiyle yapıldığını açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Ancient Roman concrete is famous for its incredible durability, with many structures like the Pantheon still standing strong after two thousand years. Modern concrete, in contrast, often begins to degrade within decades. ______. They discovered that the Romans used volcanic ash, which reacts with seawater to strengthen the chemical bonds over time.
secenekler: The Pantheon has the largest unreinforced concrete dome in the entire world.
To solve this mystery, scientists recently analyzed the microscopic chemical structure of ancient walls.
Roman builders were highly skilled engineers who constructed aqueducts across Europe.
Modern concrete companies are trying to reduce their carbon dioxide emissions dramatically.
The cost of maintaining modern concrete infrastructure is a major burden for taxpayers.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede "They discovered..." (Keşfettiler ki...) denilerek bilim insanlarının yaptığı bir araştırmanın sonucuna geçilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu durumun arkasındaki gizemi çözmek için bilim insanlarının antik duvarların mikroskobik yapısını incelediğini anlatan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The ozone layer is a thin shield of gas in the stratosphere that absorbs most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation. In the late twentieth century, scientists discovered that chemical pollutants like chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) were rapidly destroying this layer. ______. Thanks to this global ban, the ozone layer is currently on a slow path to full recovery.
secenekler: Ozone depletion is highly linked to increased rates of skin cancer and cataracts.
In response, nations signed the Montreal Protocol in nineteen eighty-seven to phase out CFCs.
CFCs were widely used in household refrigerators and aerosol spray cans in the past.
The ozone layer is located between fifteen and thirty kilometers above the Earth's surface.
Climate change is unfortunately complicating the natural recovery process of the atmosphere.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede "Thanks to this global ban" (Bu küresel yasak sayesinde) ifadesi kullanılarak bir uluslararası antlaşmaya/yasaklamaya atıfta bulunulmuştur. B seçeneğinde CFC'leri aşamalı olarak kaldırmak için ülkelerin Montreal Protokolü'nü imzaladığından bahsedilerek bu anlam bağı eksiksiz kurulmuştur.

soru_metni: In cognitive psychology, the 'spacing effect' is the phenomenon where learning is greater when studying is spread out over time. Instead of cramming all information the night before an exam, students review materials in short sessions over several weeks. ______. It allows memories to undergo neural consolidation during sleep, leading to much stronger retention.
secenekler: Most students still prefer cramming because they believe it saves a lot of time.
This distributed practice is highly effective because of how our brain stores memories.
Taking regular study breaks can prevent mental fatigue and maintain high focus.
Some academic exams test raw memorization rather than actual logical understanding.
Online flashcard applications use algorithms based on this cognitive principle.
aciklama: Aralıklı çalışma yönteminin (spacing effect) faydaları anlatılmıştır. Boşluğa, bu dağıtılmış pratiğin (this distributed practice) beynimizin hatıraları saklama biçimi nedeniyle son derece etkili olduğunu söyleyen ve devamındaki nöral konsolidasyona (neural consolidation) zemin hazırlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Hubble Space Telescope, launched in nineteen ninety, has revolutionized our understanding of the universe. By operating above the Earth's atmosphere, it avoids the atmospheric distortion that blurs ground-based telescopes. ______. These stunning observations have helped astronomers calculate the age of the universe with incredible precision.
secenekler: Hubble has been serviced several times by astronauts in orbit using space shuttles.
This clear vantage point allowed it to capture extremely detailed images of distant galaxies.
The James Webb Space Telescope is much larger and more powerful than Hubble.
Ground-based telescopes are much cheaper to build and maintain than space-based ones.
Hubble was named after Edwin Hubble, a famous astronomer who discovered the expanding universe.
aciklama: Hubble'ın Dünya atmosferinin dışından gözlem yaparak atmosferik bozulmayı (atmospheric distortion) önlediği belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu avantajlı konumu "This clear vantage point" (Bu net gözlem noktası) diyerek niteleyen ve uzak galaksilerin son derece detaylı fotoğraflarını çekebildiğini anlatan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The concept of 'zero waste' is a lifestyle philosophy that aims to minimize the amount of trash sent to landfills and oceans. Followers of this movement focus on the five Rs: Refuse, Reduce, Reuse, Rot, and Recycle. ______. Instead of buying packaged products, they bring their own jars, bags, and containers to grocery stores.
secenekler: Plastic pollution is currently threatening several endangered marine animal species.
The primary objective is to redesign our consumer habits to prevent waste creation.
Many local municipalities are introducing strict organic composting programs lately.
Recycling is often highly energy-intensive and less effective than reducing consumption.
Some zero-waste products can be much more expensive than standard plastic ones.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra kişilerin paketli ürünler almak yerine markete kendi kavanoz ve çantalarını götürdüğünden bahsedilerek tüketici alışkanlıklarına değinilmiştir. Boşluğa, hareketin temel amacının atık oluşumunu önlemek için tüketici alışkanlıklarımızı yeniden tasarlamak (redesign our consumer habits) olduğunu söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Great Barrier Reef, stretching over two thousand kilometers off Australia, is the largest coral reef system in the world. It supports a diverse array of marine life and contributes billions of dollars to the local economy. ______. Rising ocean temperatures cause corals to expel the colorful algae living inside them, leaving them bone-white and vulnerable to death.
secenekler: Coral reefs are often described as the 'rainforests of the ocean' due to their biodiversity.
However, this magnificent natural wonder is currently facing a catastrophic bleaching crisis.
Many tourists visit the reef every year for scuba diving and underwater photography.
Corals are actually colonial marine animals, not plants as many people mistakenly believe.
The government has recently implemented strict fishing bans inside the protected zones.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra okyanus sıcaklıklarındaki artışın mercanların içindeki renkli algleri dışarı atmasına (expel the colorful algae) yani "mercan ağarmasına" (bleaching) yol açtığı açıklanmıştır. Boşluğa, "However" geçişiyle başlayıp bu muazzam doğal harikanın yıkıcı bir ağarma kriziyle (bleaching crisis) karşı karşıya olduğunu belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: For decades, public health campaigns focused almost exclusively on fat as the primary cause of obesity and heart disease. However, recent nutritional science has shifted the blame toward refined sugar. ______. This constant insulin spike encourages the body to store fat and leads to insulin resistance over time.
secenekler: Fat contains nine calories per gram, while sugar contains only four calories.
Consuming high amounts of sugar causes a rapid rise in blood glucose and insulin levels.
Most processed food products contain hidden added sugars under various chemical names.
Some countries have placed a special tax on sugary carbonated sodas to reduce intake.
Replacing sugar with artificial sweeteners might not be as healthy as once thought.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra "This constant insulin spike" (Bu sürekli insülin yükselmesi) ifadesiyle insülin seviyelerindeki ani artışa gönderme yapılmıştır. Boşluğa, yüksek miktarda şeker tüketmenin kan şekerini ve insülin seviyelerini hızla yükselttiğini (rapid rise in blood glucose and insulin levels) belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The library of Alexandria was the largest and most famous library of the ancient world. Established in the third century BC, it aimed to gather all human knowledge in one place. ______. Most historians believe that a series of fires, neglect, and political conflicts gradually destroyed the scrolls over several centuries.
secenekler: The library was part of a larger research institution known as the Musaeum.
Unfortunately, none of the original manuscripts have survived to the modern era.
Julius Caesar is often blamed for accidentally burning the library during his invasion.
The collection was estimated to contain over four hundred thousand papyrus scrolls.
Many ancient scholars, like Eratosthenes and Euclid, worked and studied in Alexandria.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede kütüphanedeki parşömenlerin (scrolls) yangınlar, ihmal ve çatışmalarla yüzyıllar içinde nasıl yok olduğundan bahsedilmektedir. Boşluğa, "Maalesef, orijinal el yazmalarının hiçbiri modern çağa ulaşamadı" diyerek bu yok oluş durumunu başlatan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In human biology, circadian rhythms are the physical, mental, and behavioral changes that follow a twenty-four-hour cycle. Driven primarily by light and darkness, they regulate sleep, hormone release, and body temperature. ______. This sensory mismatch can lead to chronic fatigue, insomnia, and metabolic disorders.
secenekler: Most adults function best when they get between seven and eight hours of sleep daily.
However, modern lifestyle factors like late-night screen exposure can severely disrupt these cycles.
The master clock that controls circadian rhythms is located inside the hypothalamus.
Jet lag is a temporary circadian disruption caused by traveling across different time zones.
Melatonin is the primary hormone responsible for signaling sleepiness to the brain.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki "This sensory mismatch" (Bu duyusal uyumsuzluk) ifadesi, biyolojik saatimizle (ışık/karanlık algısıyla) ekranlardan gelen yapay ışığın yarattığı uyumsuzluğa atıfta bulunur. Boşluğa, modern gece ekran maruziyeti gibi faktörlerin bu döngüleri ciddi şekilde bozabileceğini (disrupt these cycles) anlatan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The black death in the fourteenth century was the most devastating pandemic in human history, wiping out up to sixty percent of the European population. The massive loss of labor fundamentally changed the feudal economic system. ______. As a result, peasants could demand higher wages and more rights, accelerating the end of serfdom.
secenekler: The plague was caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis, carried by fleas on rats.
Because of the extreme labor shortage, landowners had to compete with each other for workers.
Many medieval cities implemented strict quarantine rules to stop the spread of infection.
The church lost a significant amount of power and credibility during the plague years.
Farming lands were abandoned and turned into forests due to the massive population decline.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında "As a result, peasants could demand..." (Sonuç olarak, köylüler daha yüksek ücret talep edebildiler...) denilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu ekonomik sonucun gerekçesini oluşturan, iş gücü kıtlığı nedeniyle toprak sahiplerinin işçiler için birbirleriyle rekabet etmek zorunda kaldığını anlatan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The concept of 'biophilic design' is an architectural approach that seeks to connect building occupants more closely with nature. It involves incorporating natural elements like wood, stone, plants, and natural light into urban offices and homes. ______. For instance, studies show that offices with plants have happier employees who take fewer sick leaves.
secenekler: Urbanization has isolated most modern humans from any regular contact with nature.
The primary objective is to reduce mental stress and improve overall cognitive well-being.
Some modern skyscrapers are now being designed with vertical forests on their facades.
Using sustainable and locally sourced materials can also reduce construction carbon footprint.
Many architects believe that biophilic design is the future of sustainable green cities.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede bitkileri olan ofislerde çalışanların daha mutlu olduğu ve daha az hastalık izni aldığı belirtilmektedir. Boşluğa, tasarımın temel amacının zihinsel stresi azaltmak ve genel bilişsel refahı (cognitive well-being) iyileştirmek olduğunu açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: For centuries, the search for the Northwest Passage—a sea route connecting the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans through the Arctic—captured the minds of European explorers. Many expeditions ended in tragedy due to freezing ice and harsh winter storms. ______. However, climate change and melting Arctic ice have recently made the passage navigably viable for commercial shipping during summer months.
secenekler: The most famous tragedy was the complete disappearance of the John Franklin expedition in eighteen forty-five.
Historically, the route was considered entirely impassable for commercial ships.
Explorers were highly motivated by the potential trade savings with East Asian markets.
The passage is located in the northern territory of Canada and the Arctic Circle.
Modern icebreakers are still necessary to guide ships safely through the remaining ice sheets.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında "However, climate change..." (Ancak, iklim değişikliği geçidi ticari nakliye için elverişli kıldı) denilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu duruma karşıtlık oluşturan ve geçidin geçmişte ticari gemiler için tamamen imkansız/geçilmez (historically... entirely impassable) kabul edildiğini belirten B seçeneği yerleşmelidir.

soru_metni: In linguistics, the 'critical period hypothesis' suggests that there is a biological window in childhood during which language acquisition is natural and effortless. After this period, which typically ends around puberty, learning a language becomes much more analytical and difficult. ______. While children absorb grammar intuitively through exposure, adults must study rules systematically.
secenekler: Bilingual children generally perform better in standard academic tests at school.
This difference in learning styles is due to the decline in neural plasticity as we age.
Some researchers argue that children are not actually faster at learning vocabulary than adults.
The prefrontal cortex is the primary brain region responsible for analytical thinking.
Learning a foreign language is still highly beneficial for preventing dementia in old age.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede çocukların maruz kalma yoluyla sezgisel olarak, yetişkinlerin ise kuralları sistematik çalışması gerektiğinden bahsedilmiştir. Boşluğa, öğrenme stillerindeki bu farkın yaşlandıkça azalan nöral plastisiteden (decline in neural plasticity as we age) kaynaklandığını açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The invention of the steam engine in the eighteenth century was the primary catalyst for the Industrial Revolution. By converting heat energy into mechanical work, it allowed factories to operate independently of water currents. ______. Trains and steamships could transport raw materials and finished products across vast distances with unprecedented speed.
secenekler: James Watt is often credited with improving the efficiency of early steam engine designs.
Additionally, the technology revolutionized the transportation of goods and passengers globally.
Coal became the dominant global source of energy, replacing wood and water power.
The rapid urbanization of the nineteenth century led to severe public health crises in cities.
Many traditional hand-craft artisans protested against the automation of textile factories.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında trenlerin ve buharlı gemilerin ham maddeleri ve mamul ürünleri benzeri görülmemiş bir hızla taşıyabildiğinden bahsedilmektedir. Boşluğa, bu teknolojinin küresel olarak yük ve yolcu taşımacılığında devrim yarattığını (revolutionized the transportation of goods and passengers) belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The concept of 'micro-learning' involves breaking down educational content into small, highly focused bites, usually lasting under five minutes. It is designed to match the busy schedules and shorter attention spans of modern learners. ______. By delivering information in small pieces, it prevents cognitive overload and improves information retention.
secenekler: Most traditional university courses still rely on long, two-hour lecture formats.
This approach is highly effective because of how the human brain processes information.
Many mobile applications use micro-learning to teach language vocabulary quickly.
Some critics argue that small bites of information do not allow for deep critical analysis.
Online education has become a multi-billion dollar industry over the last decade.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede bilginin küçük parçalar halinde sunulmasının "bilişsel aşırı yüklenmeyi" (cognitive overload) önlediği ve akılda kalıcılığı artırdığı açıklanmıştır. Boşluğa, bu yöntemin insan beyninin bilgiyi işleme şekli (how the human brain processes information) sayesinde çok etkili olduğunu söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The giant panda is one of the most famous and endangered animal species in the world. Its diet consists almost entirely of bamboo, which is extremely low in nutrients and calories. ______. To conserve energy, pandas move slowly, avoid steep slopes, and spend up to twelve hours a day sleeping.
secenekler: Bamboo forests in China are rapidly disappearing due to expanding agricultural lands.
Consequently, pandas must consume massive quantities of it daily just to survive.
Many wildlife protection organizations are working to establish secure bamboo corridors.
Giant pandas have a special pseudo-thumb on their paws to help them grip bamboo stems.
The government has recently implemented strict penalties and fines for illegal poaching.
aciklama: Pandaların neredeyse sadece besin ve kalori değeri çok düşük olan bambuyla beslendikleri belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bunun bir sonucu olarak "Consequently, pandas must consume massive quantities..." (Sonuç olarak, pandalar sadece hayatta kalabilmek için her gün devasa miktarlarda bambu tüketmelidir) diyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Rosetta Stone, discovered in seventeen ninety-nine by French soldiers, is one of the most important archaeological finds of all time. It features a decree written in three different scripts: Hieroglyphic, Demotic, and Ancient Greek. ______. By comparing the known Greek text with the hieroglyphs, scholar Jean-François Champollion finally cracked the code in eighteen twenty-two.
secenekler: The stone is currently on display in the British Museum, despite repatriation demands from Egypt.
This trilingual inscription provided the key to deciphering ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs.
The decree was issued by King Ptolemy the Fifth during his reign in Alexandria.
Hieroglyphic writing had been completely obsolete and forgotten for over fifteen centuries.
Archaeology was not yet a professional scientific field when the stone was discovered.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında Eski Yunanca metin ile hiyerogliflerin karşılaştırılarak şifrenin çözüldüğü (cracked the code) anlatılmaktadır. Boşluğa, bu üç dilli yazıtın (trilingual inscription) hiyerogliflerin deşifre edilmesinde (deciphering ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs) anahtar rolü üstlendiğini belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In economics, the 'tragedy of the commons' is a situation where individual users act independently according to their own self-interest, depleting a shared resource. Examples include overfishing, deforestation, and air pollution. ______. Without strict regulation or private ownership, the shared resource inevitably collapses under the pressure of collective greed.
secenekler: Many environmental regulations are difficult to enforce on international waters.
This phenomenon occurs because there is no immediate cost to the individual for overusing the resource.
The concept was first described by economist Garrett Hardin in nineteen sixty-eight.
Some communities have successfully managed shared resources through traditional social rules.
Deforestation in the Amazon rainforest is a major contributor to global carbon emissions.
aciklama: Ortak kaynakların bireylerin bencil çıkarları nedeniyle tükenmesi durumundan bahsedilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu durumun neden meydana geldiğini "birey için kaynağı aşırı kullanmanın anlık hiçbir maliyetinin olmamasıyla" açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Voyager one and two space probes, launched in nineteen seventy-seven, are the longest-operating spacecraft in history. Their primary mission was to explore the gas giants of the outer solar system. ______. Even after nearly fifty years, they continue to transmit data back to Earth as they travel through the cold expanse of interstellar space.
secenekler: Voyager one carries a golden record with sounds and images of Earth for alien civilizations.
However, they have now crossed the heliopause and entered interstellar space.
The probes are powered by plutonium-238 radioisotope thermoelectric generators.
NASA plans to shut down the scientific instruments on both probes sometime after 2025.
Voyager two is the only spacecraft to have visited Uranus and Neptune up close.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında araçların yıldızlararası uzayın soğuk boşluğunda (interstellar space) ilerlerken hala Dünya'ya veri göndermeye devam ettikleri belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu durumu "Ancak, şu an heliopozu geçtiler ve yıldızlararası uzaya girdiler" geçişiyle kuran B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In agriculture, 'crop rotation' is the practice of growing different types of crops in the same area across sequential seasons. This technique has been used since ancient times to maintain soil fertility and reduce pests. ______. For instance, planting nitrogen-fixing legumes like beans can naturally enrich the soil for the next season's wheat.
secenekler: Most modern commercial farms rely on chemical nitrogen fertilizers instead of crop rotation.
By changing the crop types, farmers prevent the depletion of specific soil nutrients.
Crop rotation can also prevent soil erosion and water runoff during heavy rainfall.
The practice was highly developed by British farmers during the agricultural revolution.
Different crop varieties require different amounts of water and sunlight to grow fully.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede toprağa azot bağlayan fasulye ekiminin sonraki sezonun buğdayı için toprağı doğal olarak zenginleştireceği örneği verilmiştir. Boşluğa, mahsul türlerini değiştirerek çiftçilerin belirli toprak besin maddelerinin tükenmesini önlediklerini (prevent the depletion of specific soil nutrients) belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The concept of 'emotional contagion' is the phenomenon where people automatically mimic and synchronize the emotions of others. During face-to-face interactions, we unconsciously adopt the facial expressions, postures, and vocal tones of our companions. ______. This immediate emotional mirroring is crucial for building empathy and social bonds in human communities.
secenekler: Social media platforms have been shown to facilitate emotional contagion online as well.
This automatic mimicry then triggers the corresponding emotional state in our own brain.
Some people are naturally more sensitive to emotional contagion than others.
Emotional intelligence is the ability to recognize and manage your own emotional state.
Laughter is perhaps the most famous and contagious positive emotion among humans.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde yüz yüze iletişimde başkalarının jest ve mimiklerini bilinçsizce taklit ettiğimiz (unconsciously adopt...) anlatılmıştır. Boşluğa, bu otomatik taklit sürecinin ardından beynimizde aynı duygusal durumu tetiklediğini (triggers the corresponding emotional state...) açıklayan B seçenemelidir. 📁 Ayrıca bu paketi toplu bir şekilde inceleyebilmeniz için Studio panelinizde yds-paragraf-tamamlama-paket1.md adıyla kaydettim.
