soru_metni: The Amazon rainforest is home to about ten percent of the world's known biodiversity. It produces a vast amount of oxygen and plays a critical role in stabilizing the global climate. ______. If the current rate of deforestation continues, we could lose this vital carbon sink, accelerating global warming dramatically.
secenekler: Many pharmaceutical companies search for rare plants in the jungle.
However, this invaluable ecosystem is being destroyed rapidly by illegal logging.
Ecotourism has become a highly popular source of income for local residents.
Scientists have discovered several new bird species in the canopy recently.
The Amazon River is the largest river in the world by water volume.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra ormansızlaşmanın (deforestation) devam etmesi halinde bu hayati karbon yutağının kaybedileceği ve küresel ısınmanın hızlanacağı uyarısı yapılmaktadır. Girişteki olumlu ekolojik niteliklerden bu tehdide geçişi "However" (Ancak) bağlacıyla kuran ve yasa dışı ağaç kesiminden (illegal logging) bahseden B seçeneği akışa tam oturur.

soru_metni: For decades, traditional schools focused almost entirely on academic performance, ignoring emotional growth. However, modern educators now emphasize the importance of social-emotional learning (SEL). ______. Studies show that students with these skills are more successful academically and have healthier relationships in adult life.
secenekler: Academic exams remain the most objective way to evaluate school performance.
This approach helps children identify and manage their feelings, build empathy, and resolve conflicts.
Many high schools are currently cutting their physical education budgets.
Some parents prefer home-schooling because they want to control the curriculum.
Technical training programs are essential for preparing students for the modern labor market.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce sosyal-duygusal öğrenmenin (SEL) öneminden bahsedilmektedir. Boşluktan hemen sonra gelen "these skills" (bu beceriler) ifadesini açıklayan; çocukların duygularını yönetmelerine, empati kurmalarına ve çatışmaları çözmelerine yardımcı olan bu yaklaşımı (This approach) tanımlayan B seçeneği anlamca mükemmel bir bağ kurar.

soru_metni: The invention of the printing press by Johannes Gutenberg in the 15th century completely revolutionized human communication. Before its creation, books had to be copied by hand, making them incredibly rare and expensive. ______. This rapid dissemination of information fueled the Scientific Revolution and the Renaissance.
secenekler: Gutenberg spent most of his life in the German city of Mainz.
The technology allowed for the rapid, mass production of books at a fraction of the cost.
Most medieval citizens were completely illiterate and could not read.
Scribes in monasteries frequently protested against the automation of copying.
Paper production had to be imported from East Asia before printing could begin.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce kitapların elle kopyalandığı ve nadir/pahalı olduğu söylenmiş, boşluktan sonra ise bilginin hızlı yayılmasının (rapid dissemination) dünyayı değiştirdiği vurgulanmıştır. Matbaanın kitapların hızlı ve çok daha düşük bir maliyetle seri üretilmesini (mass production... fraction of the cost) sağladığını belirten B seçeneği bu iki durum arasındaki geçişi kusursuz sağlar.

soru_metni: In marine biology, bioluminescence is the production and emission of light by a living organism. It is incredibly common in the deep ocean, where solar light cannot penetrate. ______. Others use their glowing bodies to startle predators or signal potential mates in the absolute darkness.
secenekler: Many deep-sea fish are endangered due to commercial overfishing.
Some organisms use this light as a lure to attract unsuspecting prey.
Marine biologists use special cameras to capture bioluminescent reactions.
Submarine volcanic eruptions can heat ocean water to extreme temperatures.
Most bioluminescent light is blue or green in color because it travels further in water.
aciklama: Boşluktan hemen sonra gelen "Others use..." (Diğerleri ise... kullanır) ifadesi, boşluğa bazı canlıların bu ışığı hangi amaçla kullandığına dair bir giriş cümlesi gerektirir. B seçeneğinde bazı organizmaların bu ışığı avlarını çekmek için bir tuzak (lure to attract unsuspecting prey) olarak kullandığı belirtilerek "bazıları... diğerleri..." paralelliği kurulmuştur.

soru_metni: Urban air pollution is a major environmental threat to public health in modern megacities. The combustion of fossil fuels in transport and industry releases toxic gases and fine particles. ______. Consequently, many cities are introducing low-emission zones and investing heavily in electric public transit.
secenekler: Acid rain can damage historical stone structures and forests severely.
These microscopic pollutants can penetrate deep into the lungs, causing respiratory and cardiovascular diseases.
Electric cars are still too expensive for the average working-class family.
Air quality monitors are installed at several key intersections across the city.
Many people prefer living in the countryside to avoid the hectic city noise.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce havaya salınan zehirli gazlardan ve ince parçacıklardan (fine particles) bahsedilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu parçacıkların sağlık üzerindeki doğrudan etkisini açıklayan ve onları "These microscopic pollutants" (Bu mikroskobik kirleticiler) olarak niteleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In culinary history, salt was once so valuable that it was used as a form of currency, even giving rise to the word 'salary.' Before the invention of modern refrigeration, it was the primary method for preserving food. ______. By drawing moisture out of meat and fish, salt effectively stopped the growth of these harmful microorganisms.
secenekler: Salt was mined primarily in deep underground caverns by enslaved laborers.
It acted as a powerful dehydrating agent that prevented the survival of bacteria.
Most modern doctors recommend reducing daily salt intake to lower blood pressure.
The salt trade routes across the Sahara Desert were highly protected by soldiers.
Sea salt is harvested by evaporating ocean water in shallow coastal pools.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonraki cümlede tuzun eti ve balığı kurutarak "zararlı mikroorganizmaların" (these harmful microorganisms) büyümesini durdurduğu belirtilmektedir. Boşluğa, tuzun bakterilerin hayatta kalmasını önleyen güçlü bir kurutucu madde (powerful dehydrating agent) olduğunu açıklayarak bu bakterilere atıfta bulunan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: For decades, economists believed that GDP was the only reliable measure of a nation's overall success and development. However, this perspective has been criticized for ignoring social well-being and environmental health. ______. This alternative index evaluates factors like life expectancy, education quality, and income equality to get a more holistic view of progress.
secenekler: Standard economic growth models assume resources are completely infinite.
In response, the United Nations developed the Human Development Index (HDI).
Many developing nations are currently struggling with high inflation rates.
Tax revenues are essential for funding public healthcare and infrastructure.
Most citizens are highly concerned about economic security and job stability.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra "This alternative index" (Bu alternatif endeks) ifadesi kullanılarak yeni bir ölçüm sistemine atıfta bulunulmuştur. B seçeneğinde Birleşmiş Milletler'in İnsani Gelişme Endeksi'ni (Human Development Index) geliştirdiği belirtilerek bu endeksin ne olduğu ve neleri değerlendirdiği netleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: The Great Wall of China is not a single continuous wall, but a vast network of defensive fortifications built over centuries. While its primary purpose was protection against northern nomadic invasions, it had other crucial functions. ______. It served as a secure, elevated corridor for transporting goods, military units, and administrative messages across rugged mountains.
secenekler: The wall is constructed primarily of local stone, rammed earth, and brick.
For instance, it played a vital role as an important trade and transport infrastructure.
Many tourists walk along the restored sections of the wall near Beijing today.
Building the wall required the forced labor of millions of peasants and soldiers.
Historically, the wall was not always successful in stopping determined invaders.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde duvarın savunma dışında başka kritik işlevleri de (other crucial functions) olduğu belirtilmiş, boşluk sonrasında ise duvarın yük, askeri birlik ve mesaj taşınmasında güvenli bir koridor olduğu detaylandırılmıştır. Bu iki durumu "For instance" (Örneğin) diyerek bağlayan ve duvarın ticaret ile ulaşım altyapısı (trade and transport infrastructure) rolünü belirten B seçeneği akışı tamamlar.

soru_metni: Sleep plays a critical role in cognitive brain function and overall physical health. During deep sleep, the brain is highly active, consolidating memories and clearing out toxic cellular waste. ______. This chronic deprivation can lead to severe memory decline, obesity, and cardiovascular diseases over time.
secenekler: Most teenagers require at least nine hours of sleep every single night.
Consequently, failing to get enough quality sleep can have devastating long-term effects.
Coffee and other caffeinated energy drinks can severely disrupt your sleep patterns.
Some people find that listening to soft rain sounds helps them fall asleep faster.
Dreaming occurs primarily during the rapid eye movement (REM) phase of sleep.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede "This chronic deprivation" (Bu kronik yoksunluk) ifadesi kullanılarak uykusuzluğa doğrudan bir atıfta bulunulmuştur. Boşluğa, yeterli kaliteli uykuyu alamamanın (failing to get enough quality sleep) uzun vadeli yıkıcı etkilerini belirterek bu yoksunluk durumunu başlatan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The concept of 'gamification' involves incorporating game-design elements, such as points and badges, into non-game contexts like education or business. By making tasks interactive and competitive, it aims to increase engagement. ______. When a task feels like an exciting challenge, people are naturally more willing to invest time and effort.
secenekler: Many mobile applications use gamification to encourage users to exercise daily.
This approach successfully leverages the human desire for achievement, reward, and status.
Some critics argue that badges and leaderboards offer only temporary motivation.
Video games are currently one of the most profitable entertainment industries globally.
Educators have been using traditional board games in classrooms for decades.
aciklama: Oyunlaştırmanın (gamification) katılımı artırma amacından ve bunu yaparken görevleri etkileşimli kılmasından bahsedilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu yaklaşımın (This approach) başarı, ödül ve statü gibi insani arzuları başarılı bir şekilde tetiklediğini belirterek devamındaki "meydan okuma" (challenge) hissini anlamca destekleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In cognitive psychology, the 'spacing effect' is the phenomenon where learning is greater when study sessions are spread out over time. Instead of cramming all information the night before an exam, students review materials in short, regular intervals. ______. This physiological process allows memories to undergo neural consolidation during sleep, leading to much stronger retention.
secenekler: Most students still prefer cramming because they believe it saves a lot of time.
This distributed practice is highly effective because of how the human brain stores information.
Taking regular study breaks can prevent mental fatigue and maintain high focus.
Some academic exams test raw memorization rather than actual logical understanding.
Online flashcard applications use algorithms based on this cognitive principle.
aciklama: Boşluktan hemen sonra "This physiological process" (Bu fizyolojik süreç) denilerek zihinsel/nöral bir mekanizmaya değinilmiştir. Boşluğa, aralıklı çalışmanın (this distributed practice) insan beyninin bilgiyi saklama biçimi nedeniyle çok etkili olduğunu söyleyen ve uyku esnasındaki hafıza konsolidasyonuna zemin hazırlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Galapagos Islands are world-famous for their unique biodiversity, which inspired Charles Darwin's theory of natural selection. Because of their extreme geographic isolation, many native species exist nowhere else on Earth. ______. Invasive species introduced by human activities, combined with rising tourism, are threatening these fragile ecosystems.
secenekler: Darwin visited the islands in eighteen thirty-five aboard the HMS Beagle.
Unfortunately, this invaluable biological heritage is currently under severe threat.
Giant tortoises are the most famous and longest-living residents of the islands.
The islands are located in the Pacific Ocean, about six hundred miles off Ecuador.
Volcanic activity continuously shapes the unique geography of the archipelago.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde adaların benzersiz biyoçeşitliliği ve coğrafi izolasyonu övülmüştür. Boşluktan hemen sonra gelen insan kaynaklı istilacı türlerin ve turizmin bu kırılgan ekosistemleri tehdit ettiği (threatening...) bilgisine geçişi "Unfortunately" (Maalesef) diyerek kuran ve biyolojik mirasın tehdit altında olduğunu belirten B seçeneği akışa tam uyar.

soru_metni: The Hubble Space Telescope, launched in nineteen ninety, has completely revolutionized our understanding of the cosmos. By operating high above the Earth's atmosphere, it avoids the atmospheric distortion that blurs ground-based telescopes. ______. These stunning observations have helped astronomers calculate the age of the universe with incredible precision.
secenekler: Hubble has been serviced several times by astronauts in orbit using space shuttles.
This clear vantage point allowed it to capture extremely detailed images of distant galaxies.
The James Webb Space Telescope is much larger and more powerful than Hubble.
Ground-based telescopes are much cheaper to build and maintain than space-based ones.
Hubble was named after Edwin Hubble, a famous astronomer who discovered the expanding universe.
aciklama: Hubble'ın Dünya atmosferinin dışından gözlem yaparak atmosferik bozulmayı (atmospheric distortion) önlediği belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu net konumu "This clear vantage point" (Bu net gözlem noktası) olarak niteleyen ve uzak galaksilerin son derece detaylı fotoğraflarını çekebildiğini söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Micro-plastics have become one of the most pervasive environmental pollutants of our time. These tiny plastic particles, measuring less than five millimeters, are now found everywhere, from deep ocean trenches to Arctic snow. ______. They are easily ingested by marine life and gradually make their way up the food chain, eventually reaching human diets.
secenekler: Most plastic waste in the oceans comes from single-use packaging and bags.
Unfortunately, their small size makes them incredibly easy for organisms to consume.
Scientists are currently developing biodegradable plastics made from cornstarch.
The physical filtration of micro-plastics from municipal tap water is extremely difficult.
Many countries have recently implemented bans on plastic microbeads in cosmetics.
aciklama: Boşluktan hemen sonra "They are easily ingested by marine life..." (Deniz canlıları tarafından kolayca yutulurlar...) ifadesi kullanılmıştır. Boşluğa, mikroplastiklerin küçük boyutlarının organizmalar tarafından tüketilmesini son derece kolaylaştırdığını belirten B seçeneği gelmeli ve anlam akışını tamamlamalıdır.

soru_metni: The Rosetta Stone, discovered in seventeen ninety-nine, is widely considered one of the most important archaeological finds of all time. It features a decree written in three different scripts: Hieroglyphic, Demotic, and Ancient Greek. ______. By comparing the known Greek text with the hieroglyphs, scholar Jean-François Champollion finally cracked the code in eighteen twenty-two.
secenekler: The stone is currently on display in the British Museum, despite repatriation demands.
This trilingual inscription provided the key to deciphering ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs.
The decree was issued by King Ptolemy the Fifth during his reign in Alexandria.
Hieroglyphic writing had been completely obsolete and forgotten for over fifteen centuries.
Archaeology was not yet a professional scientific field when the stone was discovered.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede Eski Yunanca metin ile hiyerogliflerin karşılaştırılarak şifrenin çözüldüğü (cracked the code) anlatılmaktadır. Boşluğa, bu üç dilli yazıtın (trilingual inscription) hiyerogliflerin deşifre edilmesinde (deciphering ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs) anahtar rol oynadığını belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Refined sugar is increasingly recognized as one of the primary drivers of the global obesity and diabetes epidemics. When we consume sugary foods, our blood glucose levels spike rapidly. ______. Over time, this constant chemical stress damages insulin sensitivity and leads to chronic metabolic disorders.
secenekler: Fat contains nine calories per gram, while sugar contains only four calories.
In response, the pancreas releases a massive surge of insulin to regulate the blood sugar.
Most processed food products contain hidden added sugars under various chemical names.
Some countries have placed a special tax on sugary carbonated sodas to reduce intake.
Replacing sugar with artificial sweeteners might not be as healthy as once thought.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce şekerli gıdaların kan şekerini hızla yükselttiğinden (blood glucose levels spike rapidly) bahsedilmiş, boşluktan sonra ise "this constant chemical stress" (bu sürekli kimyasal stres) ifadesiyle vücudun buna verdiği tepki vurgulanmıştır. Boşluğa, kan şekerini düzenlemek için pankreasın yoğun bir insülin salgıladığını (pancreas releases a massive surge of insulin) belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In human biology, circadian rhythms are the physical, mental, and behavioral changes that follow a twenty-four-hour cycle. Driven primarily by light and darkness, they regulate sleep, hormone release, and body temperature. ______. This sensory mismatch can lead to chronic fatigue, insomnia, and metabolic disorders over time.
secenekler: Most adults function best when they get between seven and eight hours of sleep daily.
However, modern lifestyle factors like late-night screen exposure can severely disrupt these cycles.
The master clock that controls circadian rhythms is located inside the hypothalamus.
Jet lag is a temporary circadian disruption caused by traveling across different time zones.
Melatonin is the primary hormone responsible for signaling sleepiness to the brain.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki "This sensory mismatch" (Bu duyusal uyumsuzluk) ifadesi, gözümüzün algıladığı yapay ışık ile gerçek gece-gündüz döngüsü arasındaki uyumsuzluğa atıfta bulunmaktadır. Boşluğa, modern gece ekran maruziyetinin bu döngüleri ciddi şekilde bozabileceğini (severely disrupt these cycles) belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Great Fire of London in sixteen sixty-six was a catastrophic event that destroyed most of the city's medieval wooden buildings. Over seventy thousand residents were left homeless, and major landmarks like St. Paul's Cathedral were reduced to ashes. ______. Wood was strictly banned, and all new buildings had to be constructed using brick and stone to prevent future disasters.
secenekler: The fire started in a bakery on Pudding Lane during a dry summer evening.
However, this tragedy provided a unique opportunity to rebuild the city with safer materials.
King Charles the Second actively supervised the relief efforts for the homeless victims.
Most insurance companies were established in London shortly after this massive disaster.
The rebuild plan designed by architect Christopher Wren was unfortunately rejected.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonraki cümlede yeni binaların tuğla ve taştan inşa edilmesi zorunluluğu getirilerek yangınların önlenmeye çalışıldığı belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu trajedinin şehri daha güvenli malzemelerle (safer materials) yeniden inşa etmek için benzersiz bir fırsat sunduğunu söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In economics, the 'tragedy of the commons' describes a scenario where individual users, acting independently in their own self-interest, deplete a shared resource. Examples include overfishing in international waters and air pollution. ______. Without strict regulation or private ownership, the shared resource inevitably collapses under the pressure of collective greed.
secenekler: Many environmental regulations are extremely difficult to enforce on the open seas.
This phenomenon occurs because there is no immediate financial cost to the individual for overusing the resource.
The concept was first described by economist Garrett Hardin in nineteen sixty-eight.
Some communities have successfully managed shared resources through traditional social rules.
Deforestation in the Amazon rainforest is a major contributor to global carbon emissions.
aciklama: Ortak malların bencil çıkarlar nedeniyle yok edilmesi senaryosu anlatılmaktadır. Boşluğa, bu durumun neden meydana geldiğini "birey için ortak kaynağı aşırı kullanmanın anlık hiçbir maliyetinin olmamasıyla" açıklayan ve devamındaki kolektif açgözlülük (collective greed) ifadesini gerekçelendiren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Mars Perseverance rover has been sending back extraordinary images and geological data from the red planet. Its primary mission is to search for signs of ancient microbial life in Martian rocks. ______. If scientists discover organic molecules in these clay minerals, it could prove that Mars was once habitable billions of years ago.
secenekler: Mars has two small moons, Phobos and Deimos, which are likely captured asteroids.
To do this, it is currently exploring the Jezero Crater, a dried-up ancient lake bed.
Sending humans to Mars presents severe technological and physiological challenges.
The gravity on Mars is only about thirty-eight percent of the gravity on Earth.
NASA plans to launch a manned mission to the red planet sometime in the late 2030s.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde aracın birincil görevinin antik yaşam izleri aramak olduğu söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, "To do this" (Bunu yapmak için) ifadesiyle başlayan ve aracın şu an kurumuş bir göl yatağını (Jezero Crater, a dried-up ancient lake bed) araştırdığını belirterek görevin detayını veren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Throughout history, honey has been valued not only as a sweet food but also as a powerful medicinal substance. Its extremely low moisture content and high acidity make it highly inhospitable to bacteria. ______. For this reason, ancient civilizations frequently used it to treat wounds, burns, and skin infections.
secenekler: Beekeeping was an highly respected occupation in ancient Egypt and Greece.
Consequently, it acts as a natural antiseptic that prevents bacterial growth.
Most modern doctors recommend against giving honey to infants under one year old.
Honey contains various healthy antioxidants and organic compounds.
In fact, honey can remain preserved for thousands of years without spoiling.
aciklama: Balın nemsiz ve asidik yapısının bakterilerin üremesini engellediği belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu durumun bir sonucu olarak "Consequently, it acts as a natural antiseptic..." (Sonuç olarak, bakteri gelişimini önleyen doğal bir antiseptik görevi görür) diyen ve devamındaki yara tedavisi kullanımını gerekçelendiren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The concept of 'biophilic design' is an architectural approach that seeks to connect building occupants more closely with nature. It involves incorporating natural elements like wood, stone, indoor plants, and natural light into urban offices. ______. For instance, studies show that offices with plants have happier employees who take fewer sick leaves.
secenekler: Urbanization has isolated most modern humans from any regular contact with nature.
The primary objective is to reduce mental stress and improve overall cognitive well-being.
Some modern skyscrapers are now being designed with vertical forests on their facades.
Using sustainable and locally sourced materials can also reduce construction carbon footprint.
Many architects believe that biophilic design is the future of sustainable green cities.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede bitkileri olan ofislerde çalışanların daha mutlu olduğu ve daha az hastalık izni aldığı belirtilerek bilişsel ve ruhsal faydalara değinilmiştir. Boşluğa, tasarımın temel amacının zihinsel stresi azaltmak ve genel bilişsel refahı (reduce mental stress and improve overall cognitive well-being) iyileştirmek olduğunu belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The search for the Northwest Passage—a sea route connecting the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans through the Arctic—captured the minds of European explorers for centuries. Many expeditions ended in tragedy due to freezing ice and harsh winter storms. ______. However, climate change and melting Arctic ice have recently made the passage navigably viable for commercial shipping during summer.
secenekler: The most famous tragedy was the complete disappearance of the John Franklin expedition.
Historically, the route was considered entirely impassable for commercial ships.
Explorers were highly motivated by the potential trade savings with East Asian markets.
The passage is located in the northern territory of Canada and the Arctic Circle.
Modern icebreakers are still necessary to guide ships safely through the remaining ice sheets.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında "However, climate change..." (Ancak, iklim değişikliği geçidi ticari nakliye için elverişli kıldı) denilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu duruma karşıtlık oluşturan ve geçidin geçmişte ticari gemiler için tamamen imkansız/geçilmez (historically... entirely impassable) kabul edildiğini belirten B seçeneği yerleşmelidir.

soru_metni: In linguistics, the 'critical period hypothesis' suggests that there is a biological window in childhood during which language acquisition is natural and effortless. After this period, which typically ends around puberty, learning a language becomes much more analytical. ______. While children absorb grammar intuitively through exposure, adults must study rules systematically.
secenekler: Bilingual children generally perform better in standard academic tests at school.
This difference in learning styles is due to the decline in neural plasticity as we age.
Some researchers argue that children are not actually faster at learning vocabulary than adults.
The prefrontal cortex is the primary brain region responsible for analytical thinking.
Learning a foreign language is still highly beneficial for preventing dementia in old age.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede çocukların maruz kalma yoluyla sezgisel olarak, yetişkinlerin ise kuralları çalışarak öğrendiğinden bahsedilmiştir. Boşluğa, öğrenme stillerindeki bu farkın yaşlandıkça azalan nöral plastisiteden (decline in neural plasticity as we age) kaynaklandığını açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The invention of the steam engine in the eighteenth century was the primary catalyst for the Industrial Revolution. By converting heat energy into mechanical work, it allowed factories to operate independently of water currents. ______. Trains and steamships could transport raw materials and finished products across vast distances with unprecedented speed.
secenekler: James Watt is often credited with improving the efficiency of early steam engine designs.
Additionally, the technology revolutionized the transportation of goods and passengers globally.
Coal became the dominant global source of energy, replacing wood and water power.
The rapid urbanization of the nineteenth century led to severe public health crises in cities.
Many traditional hand-craft artisans protested against the automation of textile factories.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında trenlerin ve buharlı gemilerin ham maddeleri ve mamul ürünleri benzersiz bir hızla taşıyabildiğinden bahsedilmektedir. Boşluğa, bu teknolojinin küresel olarak yük ve yolcu taşımacılığında devrim yarattığını (revolutionized the transportation of goods and passengers) belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The concept of 'micro-learning' involves breaking down educational content into small, highly focused bites, usually lasting under five minutes. It is designed to match the busy schedules of modern learners. ______. By delivering information in small pieces, it prevents cognitive overload and improves information retention.
secenekler: Most traditional university courses still rely on long, two-hour lecture formats.
This approach is highly effective because of how the human brain processes information.
Many mobile applications use micro-learning to teach language vocabulary quickly.
Some critics argue that small bites of information do not allow for deep critical analysis.
Online education has become a multi-billion dollar industry over the last decade.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede bilginin küçük parçalar halinde sunulmasının "bilişsel aşırı yüklenmeyi" (cognitive overload) önlediği ve akılda kalıcılığı artırdığı açıklanmıştır. Boşluğa, bu yöntemin insan beyninin bilgiyi işleme şekli (how the human brain processes information) sayesinde çok etkili olduğunu söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The giant panda is one of the most famous and endangered animal species in the world. Its diet consists almost entirely of bamboo, which is extremely low in nutrients and calories. ______. To conserve energy, pandas move slowly, avoid steep slopes, and spend up to twelve hours a day sleeping.
secenekler: Bamboo forests in China are rapidly disappearing due to expanding agricultural lands.
Consequently, pandas must consume massive quantities of it daily just to survive.
Many wildlife protection organizations are working to establish secure bamboo corridors.
Giant pandas have a special pseudo-thumb on their paws to help them grip bamboo stems.
The government has recently implemented strict penalties and fines for illegal poaching.
aciklama: Pandaların kalori değeri çok düşük olan bambuyla beslendikleri belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bunun bir sonucu olarak "Consequently, pandas must consume massive quantities..." (Sonuç olarak, pandalar sadece hayatta kalabilmek için her gün devasa miktarlarda bambu tüketmelidir) diyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Voyager one and two space probes, launched in nineteen seventy-seven, are the longest-operating spacecraft in history. Their primary mission was to explore the gas giants of the outer solar system. ______. Even after nearly fifty years, they continue to transmit data back to Earth as they travel through interstellar space.
secenekler: Voyager one carries a golden record with sounds and images of Earth for alien civilizations.
However, they have now crossed the heliopause and entered interstellar space.
The probes are powered by plutonium-238 radioisotope thermoelectric generators.
NASA plans to shut down the scientific instruments on both probes sometime after 2025.
Voyager two is the only spacecraft to have visited Uranus and Neptune up close.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında araçların yıldızlararası uzayda (interstellar space) ilerlerken hala Dünya'ya veri göndermeye devam ettikleri belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu durumu "Ancak, şu an heliopozu geçtiler ve yıldızlararası uzaya girdiler" geçişiyle kuran B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In agriculture, 'crop rotation' is the practice of growing different types of crops in the same area across sequential seasons. This technique has been used since ancient times to maintain soil fertility and reduce pests. ______. For instance, planting nitrogen-fixing legumes like beans can naturally enrich the soil for the next season's wheat.
secenekler: Most modern commercial farms rely on chemical nitrogen fertilizers instead of crop rotation.
By changing the crop types, farmers prevent the depletion of specific soil nutrients.
Crop rotation can also prevent soil erosion and water runoff during heavy rainfall.
The practice was highly developed by British farmers during the agricultural revolution.
Different crop varieties require different amounts of water and sunlight to grow fully.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede toprağa azot bağlayan fasulye ekiminin sonraki sezonun buğdayı için toprağı doğal olarak zenginleştireceği örneği verilmiştir. Boşluğa, mahsul türlerini değiştirerek çiftçilerin belirli toprak besin maddelerinin tükenmesini önlediklerini (prevent the depletion of specific soil nutrients) belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The concept of 'emotional contagion' is the phenomenon where people automatically mimic and synchronize the emotions of others. During face-to-face interactions, we unconsciously adopt the facial expressions and vocal tones of our companions. ______. This immediate emotional mirroring is crucial for building empathy and social bonds.
secenekler: Social media platforms have been shown to facilitate emotional contagion online as well.
This automatic mimicry then triggers the corresponding emotional state in our own brain.
Some people are naturally more sensitive to emotional contagion than others.
Emotional intelligence is the ability to recognize and manage your own emotional state.
Laughter is perhaps the most famous and contagious positive emotion among humans.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde yüz yüze iletişimde başkalarının jest ve mimiklerini bilinçsizce taklit ettiğimiz (unconsciously adopt...) anlatılmıştır. Boşluğa, bu otomatik taklit sürecinin ardından beynimizde aynı duygusal durumu tetiklediğini (triggers the corresponding emotional state...) açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Sahara Desert was not always an arid wasteland. Geological evidence shows that thousands of years ago, it was a green landscape covered with lakes, rivers, and grasslands. ______. This rapid shift forced the early human populations of the region to migrate toward the Nile River Valley, fueling the rise of ancient Egyptian civilization.
secenekler: Cave paintings in the Sahara depict various wild animals like giraffes and hippos.
However, a subtle shift in the Earth's orbit around five thousand years ago triggered a rapid drying process.
Today, the Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world, spanning several nations.
Some desert plants have evolved seeds that can stay dormant in dry soil for years.
Dust storms from the Sahara can transport mineral nutrients across the Atlantic Ocean.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce Sahra'nın eskiden yeşil ve nehirlerle dolu bir bölge olduğu belirtilmiş, boşluktan sonra ise "This rapid shift" (Bu hızlı değişim) ifadesiyle kuraklaşmaya ve göçe değinilmiştir. Boşluğa, Dünya'nın yörüngesindeki küçük bir değişikliğin hızlı bir kuruma sürecini tetiklediğini (triggered a rapid drying process) söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In evolutionary biology, altruism refers to behavior by an individual that increases the fitness of another individual while decreasing its own. This seems to contradict the raw 'survival of the fittest' principle. ______. By helping close relatives who share their genes, individuals ensure the survival of their own genetic lineage.
secenekler: Charles Darwin was highly puzzled by the cooperative behavior of social insects like ants.
However, evolutionary biologists explain this paradox through the concept of 'kin selection.'
Some animals display selfish behaviors when resources like food and water are scarce.
Altruistic acts are extremely common among highly social mammal species like dolphins.
Most evolutionary models assume that genetic mutations occur completely at random.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce özgeciliğin (altruism) evrimdeki "en güçlü olanın hayatta kalması" ilkesiyle çeliştiği belirtilmiştir. Boşluktan hemen sonra gelen yakın akrabalara yardım ederek genlerin hayatta kalmasını sağlama açıklaması, boşluğa bu paradoksun "akraba seçilimi" (kin selection) kavramıyla açıklandığını belirten B seçeneğinin gelmesini gerektirir.

soru_metni: The Dead Sea, bordered by Jordan and Israel, is the lowest elevation point on the Earth's land surface. It is extremely salty, with a salinity level nearly ten times higher than ordinary ocean water. ______. No fish or plants can survive in its waters, which is how the sea earned its famous name.
secenekler: The high mineral concentration allows tourists to float effortlessly on the water.
This extreme chemical environment makes it completely uninhabitable for most complex life.
Many luxury wellness resorts have been built along the shores of the lake recently.
The Jordan River is the primary source of water flowing into the landlocked basin.
Mineral-rich mud from the sea is widely exported for cosmetic and therapeutic uses.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce Lut Gölü'nün aşırı tuzlu olduğundan bahsedilmiş, boşluktan hemen sonra ise "hiçbir balık veya bitkinin orada yaşayamayacağı" (No fish or plants can survive...) söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, bu aşırı kimyasal ortamın canlılar için burayı tamamen yaşanmaz kıldığını (completely uninhabitable) belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The placebo effect is a remarkable phenomenon where a patient's symptoms improve after receiving a useless treatment, like a sugar pill. For decades, it was dismissed as a purely psychological trick. ______. Brain scans show that expecting a treatment to work can trigger the actual release of natural pain-killing chemicals in the brain.
secenekler: Clinical drug trials must always use a double-blind setup to control for this effect.
However, modern neuroscience has discovered that the effect has a physical, biological basis.
Some patients report experiencing negative side effects even from inactive placebo pills.
The history of medicine is filled with strange treatments that relied entirely on belief.
Most doctors believe that honesty is essential when prescribing any medical treatment.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde plasebo etkisinin geçmişte sadece psikolojik bir hile (purely psychological trick) olarak görüldüğü belirtilmiştir. Boşluktan hemen sonra ise beyin taramalarının (Brain scans) bu beklentinin beyinde fiziksel kimyasallar salgılattığını gösterdiği söylenmiştir. Bu fiziksel, biyolojik temeli (physical, biological basis) duyuran B seçeneği akışa tam uyar.

soru_metni: In industrial design, the principle of 'planned obsolescence' involves intentionally designing products to have a limited lifespan. By ensuring that devices break or become outdated within a few years, companies encourage consumers to buy upgrades. ______. Millions of discarded smartphones and laptops are filling landfills annually, releasing toxic heavy metals into the soil.
secenekler: This business strategy was first widely adopted during the automotive boom of the 1920s.
While highly profitable for corporations, this practice has devastating environmental consequences.
Many consumer protection groups are lobbying for a legal 'right to repair' their electronics.
Software updates often slow down older models, forcing users to purchase newer versions.
Recycling electronic waste is highly expensive and requires specialized chemical facilities.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde şirketlerin ürün ömrünü kısa tutarak tüketimi teşvik ettiğinden bahsedilmiştir. Boşluk sonrasında ise milyonlarca atık telefonun toprağa zehir saçtığı belirtilerek çevre kirliliğine vurgu yapılmıştır. Bu duruma "While highly profitable..." (Şirketler için karlı olsa da...) diyerek çevresel sonuçlara (environmental consequences) dikkat çeken B seçeneği mükemmel bir köprüdür.

soru_metni: The Silk Road was not a single highway, but a vast network of ancient trade routes connecting China with the Mediterranean world. While luxury goods like silk and jade were the primary commodities, they were not the most important exchange. ______. Religions like Buddhism and Islam, along with technologies like paper-making, spread across continents, shaping human history.
secenekler: Many merchants faced extreme dangers from bandits and harsh mountain weather.
In fact, the routes allowed for an highly significant cultural and technological exchange.
The trade routes declined rapidly after the collapse of the Mongol Empire in the 14th century.
Glassware from Rome was highly prized by Chinese emperors and nobles of the Han Dynasty.
Marco Polo is perhaps the most famous traveler to have documented his journey along the road.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede Budizm ve İslam gibi dinlerin, kağıt yapımı gibi teknolojilerin kıtalar arasında yayıldığı belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu rotaların asul önemli yanının "kültürel ve teknolojik alışverişe" (cultural and technological exchange) izin vermesi olduğunu belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The concept of 'herd immunity' occurs when a large portion of a community becomes immune to a disease, making the spread of infection unlikely. This can be achieved either through natural recovery or widespread vaccination. ______. This protective shield is especially vital for individuals who cannot be vaccinated due to leukemia or severe allergies.
secenekler: Widespread vaccination campaigns have successfully eradicated diseases like smallpox globally.
As a result, the entire population becomes protected, not just those who are immune.
Some viruses mutate rapidly, making permanent herd immunity extremely difficult to maintain.
The percentage of the population required for herd immunity varies depending on the virus.
Many parents are highly concerned about the safety and side effects of modern vaccines.
aciklama: Boşluktan hemen sonra "This protective shield" (Bu koruyucu kalkan) ifadesiyle tüm toplumun korunmasına değinilmiştir. Boşluğa, aşılama veya iyileşme sonucunda "sadece bağışıklığı olanların değil tüm nüfusun korunduğunu" (the entire population becomes protected, not just those who are immune) açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Before the invention of modern seismographs, predicting or understanding earthquakes was entirely impossible. Ancient civilizations relied on myths and legends to explain the terrifying shaking of the ground. ______. This revolutionary device allowed scientists to record the exact arrival times of different seismic waves, marking the birth of modern seismology.
secenekler: The Richter scale is used to measure the total energy released during an earthquake.
However, the invention of the electromagnetic seismograph in the late 19th century changed everything.
Many earthquakes occur along the edges of tectonic plates, known as fault lines.
Animal behavior has been reported to change hours before a major earthquake strikes.
Building code regulations in Japan require skyscrapers to be constructed with flexible joints.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde geçmişte depremleri anlamanın imkansız olduğundan ve mitlere dayanıldığından bahsedilmiştir. Boşluktan hemen sonra gelen "This revolutionary device" (Bu devrimsel cihaz) ifadesini niteleyen ve 19. yüzyılın sonlarında elektromanyetik sismografın icat edildiğini belirten B seçeneği akışı mükemmel bağlar.

soru_metni: The domestic cat is one of the most popular pets in the world, valued for companionship and pest control. However, their global expansion has come with a high ecological cost. ______. Because they retain their wild hunting instincts, domestic cats have contributed to the extinction of dozens of bird and mammal species.
secenekler: Most cats are highly independent and require much less daily care than dogs.
Indeed, they are widely recognized as one of the most destructive invasive predators globally.
Some cities have implemented strict curfew laws requiring owners to keep cats indoors at night.
Cats were worshipped as sacred animals in ancient Egypt, associated with several gods.
Feeding stray cats in urban parks can unfortunately increase the local rodent population.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde kedilerin ekolojik bir maliyeti (high ecological cost) olduğundan bahsedilmiş, boşluktan sonra ise yabani avlanma içgüdüleri nedeniyle birçok kuş ve memeli türünün neslinin tükenmesine yol açtıkları belirtilmiştir. Bu durumu destekleyen ve kedileri "en yıkıcı istilacı yırtıcılardan biri" (one of the most destructive invasive predators) olarak tanımlayan B seçeneği akışa tam uyar.

soru_metni: In educational research, the 'Flipped Classroom' is a pedagogical model where traditional lecture and homework elements are reversed. Students study new concepts at home by watching recorded video lectures. ______. This active learning setup allows teachers to offer highly personalized guidance to students during class hours.
secenekler: Most public schools still do not have the necessary funding to purchase tablets for students.
Then, they spend their classroom time engaging in interactive discussions, group projects, and exercises.
Online education became extremely popular worldwide during the recent pandemic years.
Some studies suggest that students miss the direct face-to-face interaction of traditional lectures.
Teachers must spend several hours preparing high-quality instructional materials for home study.
aciklama: Ters yüz sınıf (Flipped Classroom) modelinde öğrencilerin ders konularını evde video izleyerek çalıştıkları belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu sürecin devamı olan "Ardından, sınıf zamanını etkileşimli tartışmalar ve grup projeleriyle geçirirler" (Then, they spend their classroom time...) açıklamasını getiren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Deep-sea hydrothermal vents are fissures on the ocean floor that geothermally heat water to extreme temperatures. When this mineral-rich water meets freezing ocean water, it deposits minerals, forming giant chimneys. ______. Instead of relying on sunlight, the entire ecosystem is powered by chemosynthetic bacteria that convert toxic chemicals into energy.
secenekler: Marine biologists use advanced robotic submarines to collect water samples from the vents.
Surprisingly, these dark, high-pressure environments support a highly unique array of life.
The vents are located thousands of meters below the surface, where total darkness prevails.
Some scientists believe that life on Earth may have originally started near these hot vents.
Hydrothermal vents are primarily found along tectonic plate boundaries in the Pacific Ocean.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında derin deniz kaplıcalarının etrafındaki ekosistemin güneş ışığı yerine kemosentetik bakterilere dayandığı (ecosystem is powered by chemosynthetic bacteria) açıklanmıştır. Boşluğa, şaşırtıcı bir şekilde bu karanlık ve yüksek basınçlı ortamların benzersiz bir yaşam çeşitliliğini (unique array of life) desteklediğini belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The leaning tower of Pisa has been a source of fascination and concern for engineers since its construction began in the 12th century. The tilt is not an intentional design, but an engineering accident. ______. Over the centuries, several stabilization efforts have been implemented to keep the iconic monument from collapsing completely.
secenekler: The tower was built as a free-standing bell tower for the nearby cathedral of Pisa.
It began to lean during construction because the foundation was laid on soft, shifting soil.
Tourists from all over the world visit the monument to take creative optical illusion photos.
The government closed the tower to the public in nineteen ninety for extensive safety repairs.
Most historical towers in Europe suffer from minor tilts due to aging stone foundations.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce kulenin eğikliğinin kasıtlı bir tasarım değil, bir mühendislik kazası (engineering accident) olduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu eğilmenin temel nedenini "temelin yumuşak ve hareketli toprak üzerine atılmasıyla" (foundation was laid on soft, shifting soil) açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The introduction of the grey squirrel from North America to the UK in the 19th century is a classic case of an ecological disaster. The grey squirrel rapidly outcompeted the native red squirrel for food and territory. ______. Consequently, the red squirrel population has crashed, and they are now endangered in most parts of the country.
secenekler: Red squirrels are much smaller and have iconic tufted ears that grey squirrels lack.
Furthermore, they carried a deadly virus, known as squirrel pox, to which red squirrels had no immunity.
Many wildlife groups are currently setting up secure feeding zones for red squirrels in Scotland.
Grey squirrels prefer eating acorns from oak trees, which are highly abundant in British forests.
Most invasive species are introduced accidentally through international cargo shipping vessels.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde gri sincapların yerli kızıl sincaplarla rekabet ederek onları geride bıraktığı anlatılmıştır. Boşluğa, bu rekabete ek olarak "Furthermore" (Dahası) geçişiyle gri sincapların kızıl sincapların bağışıklığı olmayan ölümcül bir virüs (deadly virus) taşıdığını belirten ve kızıl sincapların yok olma sürecini hızlandıran B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In art history, Impressionism was a major 19th-century movement that rejected the strict rules of classical academic painting. Instead of painting historical scenes in indoor studios, Impressionists painted outdoors. ______. By using short, visible brushstrokes, they aimed to capture the fleeting effects of light and atmosphere in real-time.
secenekler: Claude Monet's painting, 'Impression, Sunrise,' actually gave the entire movement its name.
This shift was highly enabled by the invention of portable paint tubes, allowing mobility.
Classical academic painting focused heavily on precise, invisible brushstrokes and dark colors.
Impressionist artists were initially heavily criticized and rejected by the official Paris Salon.
Most Impressionist paintings depict scenes of modern middle-class leisure and urban landscapes.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce Empresyonistlerin kapalı stüdyolar yerine açık havada (outdoors) resim yaptıklarından bahsedilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu hareketliliği ve açık havada resim yapma geçişini taşınabilir boya tüplerinin icadıyla (invention of portable paint tubes, allowing mobility) ilişkilendirerek açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Great Blue Hole, located off the coast of Belize, is a giant marine sinkhole that attracts divers from all over the world. During the last Ice Age, when sea levels were much lower, it was a dry, dark limestone cave system. ______. When the ice melted and ocean levels rose rapidly, the roof of the cavern collapsed, forming the deep blue circle we see today.
secenekler: Charles Darwin described the Belize Barrier Reef as the most remarkable reef in the West Indies.
Over thousands of years, water dripping through the dry caves formed massive stalactites.
The sinkhole is over three hundred meters wide and more than one hundred meters deep.
Many rare shark species, like the Caribbean reef shark, are commonly spotted inside the hole.
Most tourists visit the natural wonder as part of a guided day-trip tour from Belize City.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce Büyük Mavi Delik'in buzul çağında kuru bir kireçtaşı mağara sistemi (dry, dark limestone cave system) olduğu söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, bu kuru mağara döneminde suların damlayarak devasa sarkıtlar oluşturduğunu (water dripping through the dry caves formed massive stalactites) anlatan ve ardından gelen tavanın çökmesi (roof collapsed) sürecini hazırlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Prolonged screen exposure before bedtime is widely known to cause sleep difficulties, especially in teenagers. This is not just because screens keep the mind active. ______. This hormonal delay tricks the brain into thinking it is still daytime, making it extremely difficult to fall asleep quickly.
secenekler: Most teenagers spend up to four hours daily on social media applications.
More importantly, the blue light emitted by devices actively suppresses the production of melatonin.
Parents should implement strict screen-free rules in bedrooms after nine PM.
Reading a physical book is still highly recommended as a healthy pre-sleep routine.
Insomnia can lead to severe mood swings and lack of concentration during school hours.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra "This hormonal delay" (Bu hormonal gecikme) ifadesi kullanılarak melatonin hormonunun gecikmeli salgılanmasına atıfta bulunulmuştur. Boşluğa, ekranlardan yayılan mavi ışığın melatonin üretimini baskıladığını (suppresses the production of melatonin) belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In behavioral economics, the 'loss aversion' bias suggests that people feel the pain of losing something much more intensely than the pleasure of gaining it. Psychological studies show that losing one hundred dollars hurts twice as much as finding one hundred dollars feels good. ______. To avoid the risk of regret, individuals often stick with bad investments or make highly conservative choices.
secenekler: This cognitive bias was first widely documented by psychologists Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky.
Consequently, people are naturally much more motivated to avoid losses than to achieve equivalent gains.
Many financial advisors recommend diversifying your stock portfolio to minimize risks.
Rational choice theory assumes that humans always make logical, self-interested decisions.
Some marketing campaigns successfully leverage this bias by offering limited-time trial versions.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce kayıptan kaçınma eğiliminin (loss aversion) psikolojik ve deneysel boyutu anlatılmıştır. Boşluğa, bu durumun doğal bir sonucu olarak "Consequently, people are naturally much more motivated..." (Sonuç olarak, insanlar doğal olarak kayıplardan kaçınmaya, eşdeğer kazançlar elde etmekten çok daha fazla motive olurlar) diyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The library of Alexandria was established in the third century BC with the ambitious goal of gathering all human knowledge in one place. It attracted the greatest scholars and philosophers of the ancient world. ______. Most historians believe that a combination of fires, political conflict, and neglect gradually destroyed the precious scrolls over several centuries.
secenekler: The library was part of a larger research institution known as the Musaeum.
Unfortunately, none of the original manuscripts or scrolls have survived to the modern era.
Julius Caesar is often blamed for accidentally burning the collection during his invasion.
The library was estimated to contain over four hundred thousand papyrus manuscripts.
Many famous ancient scientists, like Euclid and Eratosthenes, worked and studied there.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede kütüphanedeki parşömenlerin (scrolls) yangınlar, çatışmalar ve ihmal yüzünden zamanla nasıl yok olduğu anlatılmaktadır. Boşluğa, "Maalesef, orijinal el yazmalarının veya parşömenlerin hiçbiri modern çağa ulaşamadı" diyerek bu kayıp durumunu başlatan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Bioluminescent mushrooms, found in various tropical and temperate forests, produce a soft, glowing green light. This glowing light is not just a beautiful natural display, but has a clear biological purpose. ______. Once these insects land on the mushrooms, they accidentally collect and distribute the fungal spores across the forest floor.
secenekler: Fungal spores are extremely light and can be carried easily by wind currents.
It acts as a powerful lure to attract nocturnal insects in the dark undercanopy.
Scientists are currently researching these fungi for sustainable street lighting projects.
Most bioluminescent fungi grow primarily on decaying wood or rich, organic forest soil.
The chemical reaction that produces the green light involves the luciferase enzyme.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında böceklerin mantarların üzerine konarak mantar sporlarını orman tabanına dağıttıkları (distribute the fungal spores) belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu ışığın gececil böcekleri çekmek için güçlü bir tuzak (powerful lure to attract nocturnal insects) görevi gördüğünü açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The transition to wind energy has some unforeseen ecological downsides that scientists are currently trying to mitigate. Giant wind turbines, while producing clean energy, can disrupt local wildlife. ______. To solve this, researchers are developing smart radar systems that can temporarily shut down turbines when flocks are approaching.
secenekler: Wind turbines require massive amounts of steel and concrete to construct safely.
Specifically, they pose a significant threat to migratory birds and bat populations.
Many European countries are currently investing heavily in massive offshore wind farms.
The sound produced by spinning turbine blades can cause minor noise pollution in quiet areas.
Solar energy is often considered a much safer and more reliable alternative to wind power.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında yaklaşan kuş sürüleri (flocks) olduğunda türbinleri geçici olarak durduran akıllı radar sistemlerinin geliştirildiği belirtilmektedir. Boşluğa, rüzgar türbinlerinin özellikle göçmen kuşlar ve yarasa popülasyonları için büyük bir tehdit oluşturduğunu (threat to migratory birds and bat populations) belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir. 📁 Ayrıca bu paketi toplu bir şekilde inceleyebilmeniz için Studio panelinizde yds-paragraf-tamamlama-paket2.md adıyla kaydettim.
