soru_metni: Nanotechnology is rapidly transforming modern medicine, especially in the area of cancer treatment. Traditionally, chemotherapy drugs circulate throughout the entire body, damaging healthy tissue along with cancerous cells. ______. These microscopic carriers can navigate through blood vessels to deposit medication precisely inside tumor cells, minimizing painful side effects.
secenekler: Cancer research is currently receiving more funding than any other medical field.
However, new nanobots are being designed to deliver therapies directly to targeted areas.
Chemotherapy remains the most widely used and reliable clinical intervention today.
Pharmaceutical companies must invest billions of dollars to develop and test new drugs.
Most patients suffer from chronic fatigue and hair loss during early treatment stages.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde geleneksel kemoterapinin tüm vücuda yayılarak sağlıklı hücrelere de zarar verdiğinden bahsedilmiştir. Boşluğa, "However" (Ancak) geçişiyle yeni robotik taşıyıcıların tedaviyi doğrudan hedeflenen bölgelere ilettiğini açıklayan ve devamındaki "These microscopic carriers" (Bu mikroskobik taşıyıcılar) ifadesine anlamca zemin hazırlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The rise of open-plan offices in the late 20th century was intended to foster collaboration and communication among employees. However, recent studies suggest that this layout often has the opposite effect. ______. To cope with these constant auditory distractions, many workers wear noise-canceling headphones, which actually decreases social interaction.
secenekler: Open-plan offices are much cheaper to design and build than individual rooms.
Specifically, the lack of walls creates high levels of noise that seriously disrupt focus.
Many companies are currently transitioning back to traditional closed office models.
Social collaboration is highly vital for brainstorming creative business concepts.
The average employee productivity rate has increased due to modern digital tools.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde açık ofis planının hedeflenenin aksine olumsuz etkileri olduğundan söz edilmiştir. Boşluktan hemen sonra gelen "auditory distractions" (işitsel dikkat dağıtıcı unsurlar) ifadesine doğrudan atıfta bulunarak duvarların olmayışının odaklanmayı bozan yüksek gürültü seviyeleri yarattığını belirten B seçeneği akışı tamamlar.

soru_metni: The concept of 'Blue Zones' refers to geographic regions where people live significantly longer and healthier lives than the global average. Researchers studying these areas, such as Sardinia in Italy and Okinawa in Japan, have identified several common lifestyle habits. ______. Instead of engaging in intense, structured gym workouts, they walk daily, garden, and do physical housework.
secenekler: Genetics actually play a much larger role in longevity than environmental factors.
Specifically, regular, moderate physical activity is naturally integrated into their daily routines.
Okinawa has one of the highest concentrations of centenarians in the entire world.
Most modern dietitians recommend reducing calorie intake to prevent chronic illness.
Traditional family structures in these regions provide strong emotional and social support.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra gelen "Instead of engaging in intense, structured gym workouts..." (Ağır ve planlı spor salonu egzersizleri yapmak yerine...) ifadesi, boşluktaki cümlenin günlük rutinlere entegre edilmiş hafif fiziksel aktivitelerden bahsetmesini gerektirir. B seçeneğindeki "regular, moderate physical activity" (düzenli, orta düzeyde fiziksel aktivite) ifadesi bu geçişi mükemmel sağlar.

soru_metni: The Pomodoro Technique is a popular time-management method designed to improve focus and productivity. It involves breaking your workday into twenty-five minute focused sessions, followed by short five-minute breaks. ______. This systematic rhythm prevents cognitive fatigue, allowing the brain to maintain high levels of attention throughout the day.
secenekler: The technique was developed by Francesco Cirillo in the late nineteen eighties.
After completing four consecutive sessions, users are rewarded with a much longer break.
Many mobile applications are available to help users track their study intervals.
Some critics argue that the rigid time structure can disrupt deep creative work flow.
Maintaining high focus is extremely difficult in modern digital office environments.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde tek bir çalışma ve kısa ara döngüsü (25 dakika çalışma, 5 dakika ara) tanımlanmıştır. Boşluğa, bu döngülerin tamamlanmasının ardından kullanıcıların daha uzun bir break (ara) ile ödüllendirildiğini söyleyen ve devamındaki "This systematic rhythm" (Bu sistematik ritim) ifadesini destekleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Overtourism has become a major crisis for several historic European cities, such as Amsterdam and Venice. The massive influx of visitors has driven up local housing costs, forcing permanent residents to move out of city centers. ______. Local authorities are now implementing strict measures, like limiting vacation rentals and placing tourist taxes, to protect local communities.
secenekler: Many tourists prefer staying in boutique hotels rather than private holiday apartments.
Furthermore, overcrowding has put an immense strain on historical monuments and public transport.
Amsterdam is famous for its extensive canal system and highly bicycle-friendly streets.
Tourism contributes billions of euros to the local economies of these Mediterranean countries.
Most young travelers rely heavily on social media recommendations when selecting destinations.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde aşırı turizmin konut fiyatlarını artırarak yerel halkı şehir dışına göçe zorladığı belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, turizmin diğer olumsuz etkilerini "Furthermore" (Dahası) geçişiyle ekleyen ve tarihi anıtlar ile toplu taşımadaki aşırı yoğunluğu (immense strain on historical monuments...) vurgulayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Synesthesia is a rare neurological condition where the stimulation of one sensory pathway leads to involuntary experiences in a second sensory pathway. For instance, some synesthetes might taste a specific flavor when they hear a particular word. ______. Researchers believe this occurs due to unusual cross-connections between different sensory processing areas in the brain.
secenekler: Most people are born with five primary senses that operate completely independently.
Others might see distinct colors when looking at ordinary numbers or letters.
Synesthesia is highly common among famous creative artists, musicians, and writers.
Sensory processing disorders can cause severe anxiety and social withdrawal in children.
Modern brain imaging technology allows scientists to observe neural activity in real-time.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce "For instance, some..." (Örneğin, bazıları...) diyerek bir duyusal uyarım örneği verilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Others..." (Diğerleri ise...) ifadesiyle paralel bir örnek getirerek harf ve sayılara bakıldığında renk görme durumunu açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Historically, chocolate was not always the sweet, solid treat we enjoy today. For thousands of years, Mesoamerican civilizations, such as the Maya and Aztecs, consumed cocoa as a bitter, frothy liquid. ______. It was only after European colonization that sugar, vanilla, and milk were added, transforming the beverage into a sweet luxury.
secenekler: Cocoa beans were so highly valued that they were used as currency by Aztec merchants.
In fact, they believed the drink possessed divine properties and used it in sacred rituals.
The cocoa tree grows primarily in hot, humid tropical rainforests near the equator.
Modern chocolate manufacturing involves roasting and grinding the cocoa beans into paste.
Switzerland is world-famous for producing some of the highest-quality solid chocolate bars.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce çikolatanın antik uygarlıklarca acı, köpüklü bir sıvı olarak tüketildiği belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu sıvının kutsal ritüellerde kullanıldığını ve ilahi özelliklere sahip olduğuna inanıldığını ekleyen B seçeneği gelmeli ve ardından gelen Avrupalı sömürgecilerin şeker ekleme süreciyle anlam akışı devam etmelidir.

soru_metni: Ocean acidification is a direct consequence of rising carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions in the atmosphere. The oceans absorb about thirty percent of the carbon dioxide produced by human activities, lowering the pH of seawater. ______. Without these essential building blocks, organisms like corals, oysters, and crabs struggle to grow and survive, threatening the marine food web.
secenekler: Commercial fishing contributes significantly to the global economy and food security.
This chemical reaction reduces the concentration of carbonate ions, which are vital for shell building.
Some marine species can adapt surprisingly well to minor changes in water temperature.
Carbon dioxide is a greenhouse gas that traps solar heat within the Earth's atmosphere.
Rising sea levels pose an immediate threat to low-lying coastal cities and islands.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra gelen "Without these essential building blocks" (Bu temel yapı taşları olmadan...) ifadesi, deniz kabuklularının kabuk yapmak için ihtiyaç duyduğu kimyasal maddelere atıfta bulunulduğunu gösterir. B seçeneğinde karbondioksitin karbonat iyonlarının konsantrasyonunu azalttığı ve bunun kabuk oluşumu (shell building) için hayati olduğunu belirterek bu bağı kurmuştur.

soru_metni: The development of autonomous vehicles (AVs) promises to dramatically reduce traffic accidents caused by human error. However, programming these self-driving cars presents serious ethical dilemmas. ______. For example, should a self-driving car prioritize protecting its own passengers over saving a larger group of pedestrians?
secenekler: AVs rely on complex networks of cameras, radar sensors, and artificial intelligence.
Specifically, developers must teach algorithms how to make split-second decisions in unavoidable crash scenarios.
Most drivers are highly reluctant to trust autonomous systems in heavy highway traffic.
Automobile manufacturers are investing billions of dollars to test self-driving technology.
Traffic laws must be updated to clarify legal liability in accidents involving robots.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde otonom araçları programlamanın ciddi etik ikilemler (ethical dilemmas) sunduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu ikilemi somutlaştırarak kaçınılmaz kaza senaryolarında algoritmalara karar vermeyi öğretme gerekliliğinden bahseden B seçeneği gelmeli ve devamındaki yaya/yolcu kurtarma seçimi örneğiyle akış tamamlanmalıdır.

soru_metni: In the modern workplace, the concept of 'neurodiversity' encourages employers to recognize and value neurological differences, such as autism and ADHD. Instead of viewing these conditions as deficits, neurodiversity frames them as unique cognitive styles. ______. For instance, individuals with autism often exhibit extraordinary attention to detail and pattern recognition, which are highly beneficial in data-heavy tasks.
secenekler: Traditional hiring practices often focus too heavily on social skills and eye contact.
Many neurodivergent individuals possess highly specialized skills that can drive innovation.
Standardized training programs are often difficult for employees with ADHD to complete.
Human resource departments must implement strict policies against workplace discrimination.
Office environments can be customized with quiet rooms to reduce sensory overload.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde nöroçeşitliliğin benzersiz bilişsel stiller sunduğu söylenmiş, boşluk sonrasında ise buna otizmli bireylerin detaylara dikkat etmesi ve veri işlerinde başarılı olması örneği verilmiştir. Boşluğa, nöro-farklı bireylerin inovasyonu teşvik edecek oldukça uzmanlaşmış becerilere sahip olduğunu söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Vertical farming is an innovative agricultural method where crops are grown in stacked layers, often inside controlled indoor environments. By utilizing LED lighting and climate control, these farms can produce food year-round regardless of weather conditions. ______. By growing food directly inside major cities, vertical farms dramatically reduce transportation distances and carbon emissions.
secenekler: The initial cost of building a vertical farm is extremely high due to advanced technology.
Additionally, this localized setup eliminates the need for long-distance shipping.
Most traditional farmers are skeptical about the quality of crops grown without soil.
Leafy greens, like lettuce and spinach, are currently the most profitable indoor crops.
Vertical farms use up to ninety-five percent less water than traditional open-field agriculture.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede gıdanın doğrudan büyük şehirlerin içinde üretilmesinin nakliye mesafelerini ve karbon emisyonlarını ciddi oranda azalttığından bahsedilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Additionally" (Ayrıca) geçişiyle bu yerel kurulumun uzun mesafe nakliyat ihtiyacını ortadan kaldırdığını (eliminates... long-distance shipping) belirten B seçeneği yerleşmelidir.

soru_metni: The ancient Maya civilization built thriving cities in tropical environments that suffered from prolonged dry seasons. To secure a reliable water supply, Mayan engineers constructed sophisticated reservoir systems. ______. These artificial lakes were coated with plaster and clay to prevent water from leaking into the porous limestone ground.
secenekler: Rainforests provide a rich variety of wild plants and animals that the Maya hunted.
These massive storage basins could hold millions of liters of rainwater for agricultural use.
Mayan priests played a vital role in organizing public labor for monumental construction.
Agriculture in the lowlands relied heavily on slash-and-burn clearing techniques.
The collapse of the Maya civilization is often blamed on severe environmental drought.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde Maya mühendislerinin gelişmiş sarnıç ve rezervuar sistemleri (reservoir systems) inşa ettiklerinden söz edilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu devasa depolama havzalarının (These massive storage basins) tarım için milyonlarca litre yağmur suyu tutabildiğini söyleyen B seçeneği gelmeli ve devamındaki yapay göllerin sızdırmazlık tasarımıyla anlam birleşmelidir.

soru_metni: The historical development of the postal system fundamentally changed how governments and ordinary citizens communicated. In medieval Europe, messages were carried by individual couriers on horseback, which was slow and highly expensive. ______. This reliable transport network allowed letters and commercial documents to be sent across borders on fixed schedules for the first time.
secenekler: Scribes in monasteries spent decades hand-writing administrative letters for kings.
However, the creation of organized postal stations and relay networks in the sixteenth century revolutionized communication.
Most ordinary citizens in the Middle Ages were completely illiterate and could not write.
The invention of the telegraph in the nineteenth century eventually made postal mail obsolete for urgent news.
Sending valuable packages across sea routes was highly dangerous due to pirate attacks.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde orta çağdaki mesajlaşma sisteminin bireysel ulaklarla yapıldığı, yavaş ve pahalı olduğu söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, "However" (Ancak) geçişiyle 16. yüzyılda organize posta istasyonları ve aktarma ağlarının kurulmasının iletişimi kökten değiştirdiğini anlatan B seçeneği gelmeli ve devamındaki düzenli zamanlama sistemine zemin hazırlamalıdır.

soru_metni: The mystery of the Mary Celeste remains one of the most famous unsolved legends in maritime history. In eighteen seventy-two, the merchant ship was found drifting in the Atlantic Ocean, completely abandoned. ______. Despite extensive investigations and maritime court hearings, no trace of the crew was ever found, and their fate remains a complete mystery.
secenekler: The ship was carrying a highly valuable cargo of industrial alcohol to Genoa, Italy.
Surprisingly, the ship was in perfect condition with ample food and water, but the lifeboats were missing.
Pirates were known to operate in the Azores region where the ghost ship was discovered.
The captain was an highly experienced seaman with a spotless professional reputation.
Severe Atlantic storms were reported in the area days before the ship went missing.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce Mary Celeste adlı ticari geminin okyanusta tamamen terk edilmiş olarak bulunduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, şaşırtıcı bir şekilde geminin bol miktarda yiyecek/suyla kusursuz durumda olduğunu ancak can kurtaran botlarının kayıp olduğunu ekleyen B seçeneği gelmeli ve devamındaki mürettebatın asla bulunamaması gizemini desteklemelidir.

soru_metni: Synthetic biology is a groundbreaking field that combines engineering principles with biotechnology to design new biological parts and systems. Instead of simply modifying existing organisms, synthetic biologists write entirely new genetic codes from scratch. ______. This allows them to create living organisms with highly customized functions that do not exist in nature.
secenekler: Biotechnology companies are currently facing strict regulatory hurdles and public skepticism.
This allows them to create living organisms with highly customized functions that do not exist in nature.
Traditional agriculture can be enhanced by inserting single genes into crop plants.
The mapping of the human genome in 2003 was a major milestone for medical science.
Genetic mutations occur naturally over millions of years through evolutionary processes.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde sentetik biyologların sıfırdan tamamen yeni genetik kodlar yazdıkları belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu yöntemin doğada bulunmayan oldukça özelleştirilmiş işlevlere sahip canlı organizmalar yaratılmasına olanak tanıdığını (This allows them to create living organisms...) söyleyen B seçeneği gelmeli ve ardından gelen bakteri örnekleriyle akış somutlaştırılmalıdır.

soru_metni: Ocean noise pollution caused by commercial shipping and military sonar has increased dramatically over the last few decades. Sound travels much faster and further in water than in air, making the marine environment highly sensitive to acoustic disruptions. ______. This acoustic chaos can cause these marine mammals to lose their way, separate from their pods, or even beach themselves.
secenekler: Many marine biologists are currently using hydrophones to record the songs of humpback whales.
Specifically, this artificial noise severely disrupts the echolocation and communication systems of whales.
Commercial shipping routes are continuously expanding due to the rapid growth of global trade.
Whales are the largest mammals on Earth, requiring vast ocean territories to find enough food.
Some countries have recently implemented strict bans on military sonar operations in coastal waters.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında "This acoustic chaos..." (Bu akustik kaos...) denilerek deniz memelilerinin yollarını kaybetmelerinden ve karaya vurmalarından bahsedilmektedir. Boşluğa, yapay gürültülerin balinaların ekolokasyon (yön bulma) ve iletişim sistemlerini ciddi şekilde bozduğunu açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Many fitness applications are now incorporating gamification elements, such as virtual rewards, challenge badges, and social leaderboards, to motivate users. By turning daily physical activity into an interactive game, they encourage people to build healthier habits. ______. Studies show that while rewards work well initially, users often lose interest once the novelty of the game wears off.
secenekler: Fitness trackers can monitor heart rates and calories burned with incredible precision.
However, some behavioral psychologists question the long-term effectiveness of this approach.
Most users prefer working out in actual gyms rather than using mobile applications.
Social media sharing options allow users to post their daily running routes online.
Gamification has also been successfully applied in educational software and corporate training.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde oyunlaştırma unsurlarının insanları motive etmedeki başarısı övülmüştür. Boşluktan hemen sonra ise kullanıcıların bir süre sonra ilgilerini kaybettiği söylenerek yöntemin sınırları çizilmiştir. Bu olumsuz gidişatı "However" (Ancak) diyerek duyuran ve psikologların bu yaklaşımın uzun vadeli etkinliğini sorguladığını belirten B seçeneği akışa tam uyar.

soru_metni: Learning to play a musical instrument is one of the most complex cognitive tasks a human brain can perform. It requires the simultaneous coordination of visual, auditory, and motor systems. ______. Neuroscientists have found that musicians often have a larger corpus callosum, the bridge connecting the left and right hemispheres, leading to superior communication between brain areas.
secenekler: Piano lessons are generally recommended for children starting from the age of five.
Consequently, this intense multi-sensory practice physically alters the structure of the brain over time.
Most professional musicians spend up to eight hours daily practicing their instruments.
Classical music has been shown to reduce stress levels and improve sleep quality in adults.
Learning an instrument during adulthood is much more difficult due to declining neural plasticity.
aciklama: Enstrüman çalmanın görsel, işitsel ve motor sistemlerin koordinasyonunu gerektiren bilişsel bir görev olduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Consequently" (Sonuç olarak) geçişiyle bu çoklu duyusal pratiğin zamanla beynin yapısını fiziksel olarak değiştirdiğini (physically alters the structure of the brain) söyleyen ve devamındaki beyin yarımküreleri arası köprünün büyümesi bulgusuyla örtüşen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The history of the tea trade is deeply intertwined with global politics, colonial expansion, and economic rivalry. Originally consumed as a medicinal tonic in ancient China, tea eventually became a popular daily beverage across Europe. ______. This massive demand led the British East India Company to establish vast tea plantations in India, fundamentally altering the region's agriculture and economy.
secenekler: Green tea contains various healthy antioxidants that protect cells from damage.
To meet the soaring domestic demand, European nations had to import millions of pounds of tea from China.
The Boston Tea Party of seventeen seventy-three was a key event leading to the American Revolution.
Traditional tea ceremonies in Japan are highly structured and focus on mindfulness.
Tea leaves must be carefully harvested by hand to preserve the quality and flavor.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede "This massive demand" (Bu devasa talep) denilerek İngiliz Doğu Hindistan Şirketi'nin Hindistan'da büyük çay plantasyonları kurduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, Avrupa ülkelerinin Çin'den milyonlarca kilo çay ithal etmek zorunda kaldığını ve iç talebin hızla arttığını (soaring domestic demand) söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Biomimicry is the practice of looking to nature for solutions to complex human engineering problems. A classic example is the design of Japan's famous Shinkansen bullet train. ______. By mimicking the bird's long, aerodynamic beak, engineers successfully eliminated the loud sonic booms created when the train entered narrow tunnels.
secenekler: Shinkansen trains can travel at speeds of over three hundred kilometers per hour.
To solve this, the chief engineer analyzed the hunting dive of the kingfisher bird.
Bullet trains are highly energy-efficient and generate very low carbon emissions.
Modern engineers often collaborate with biologists to study aerodynamic structures.
Originally, the train's blunt nose created massive air resistance and noise pollution.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında "By mimicking the bird's long, aerodynamic beak..." (Kuşun uzun, aerodinamik gagasını taklit ederek...) denilmiştir. Boşluğa, başmühendisin bu sorunu çözmek için yalıçapkını kuşunun (kingfisher bird) avlanma dalışını incelediğini söyleyen ve gaga taklidine zemin hazırlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Scientific research shows that sleep is highly essential for memory consolidation in birds, just as it is in humans. During migration seasons, songbirds must navigate across vast distances, relying on geographical memories learned earlier. ______. Brain scans reveal that during these resting phases, birds replay the neural patterns of their songs, strengthening their vocal learning.
secenekler: Migratory birds often travel thousands of miles without any regular food sources.
To keep these navigational memories sharp, they require adequate periods of quiet sleep.
Some bird species can fly continuously for several days by sleeping with one eye open.
Homing pigeons rely on the Earth's magnetic field to find their way back home.
Songbirds usually learn their melodies from their fathers during the early spring months.
aciklama: Kuşların göç dönemlerinde coğrafi hafızalarına (geographical memories) güvendikleri belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu yön bulma hafızalarını keskin tutmak için yeterli uykuya (quiet sleep) ihtiyaç duyduklarını söyleyen ve devamındaki beyin taramaları (Brain scans) bulgularını hazırlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Gregorian calendar, introduced by Pope Gregory XIII in fifteen eighty-two, replaced the Julian calendar to correct a minor mathematical error. The Julian calendar had slightly miscalculated the solar year, causing calendar dates to drift away from seasonal events. ______. To fix this discrepancy, ten days were completely dropped from October of that year, aligning the calendar back with the sun.
secenekler: Pope Gregory was highly interested in astronomy and mathematics during his youth.
Over sixteen centuries, this small error had accumulated to a difference of ten days.
Most Protestant nations in Europe initially refused to adopt the new Catholic calendar.
Leap years are calculated every four years to keep the calendar aligned with Earth's orbit.
The solar year is approximately three hundred and sixty-five point twenty-four days long.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde Jülyen takvimindeki küçük bir hatanın zamanla mevsimsel sapmalara yol açtığı belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu küçük hatanın 16 yüzyıl boyunca birikerek 10 günlük bir farka (difference of ten days) ulaştığını söyleyen ve devamındaki takvimden 10 günün silinmesi (ten days were completely dropped) müdahalesini gerekçelendiren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The rapid shift toward remote work during the early 2020s has left a lasting impact on commercial real estate in major global cities. With fewer employees commuting daily, office occupancy rates have plummeted to historic lows. ______. Consequently, city centers are seeing a decline in foot traffic, severely hurting local cafes, restaurants, and retail shops.
secenekler: Many companies are trying to reduce costs by downsizing their corporate offices.
This decline in physical occupancy has led to high vacancy rates in downtown office buildings.
Remote workers often report higher levels of job satisfaction and personal well-being.
Some municipal governments are offering tax incentives to attract major businesses back.
Residential property values in suburban areas have risen due to increased housing demand.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde ofis kullanım oranlarının tarihi seviyelere düştüğü (plummeted to historic lows) belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, fiziksel kullanımdaki bu düşüşün şehir merkezindeki ofis binalarında yüksek boş kalma oranlarına (high vacancy rates) yol açtığını söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Voyager Golden Records, carried aboard both Voyager spacecraft launched in 1977, are intended as a message to extraterrestrial civilizations. Curated by a committee led by Carl Sagan, the records contain diverse sounds, images, and music from Earth. ______. NASA included a specialized cartridge and stylus, along with symbolic instructions on the record's cover explaining how to play it.
secenekler: The records are constructed of gold-plated copper and designed to last for billions of years.
However, the curators faced a major challenge: how would aliens know how to play the records?
Voyager one has now successfully crossed the heliopause and entered interstellar space.
The music selection includes classical compositions by Bach, Mozart, and various folk songs.
Some critics argued that sending messages into deep space could attract hostile alien species.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra NASA'nın plağın çalınabilmesi için özel iğne, kartuş ve sembolik yönergeler eklediği (symbolic instructions... explaining how to play it) belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, küratörlerin karşılaştığı temel zorluğu (uzaylıların bu plağı nasıl çalacağını nasıl bileceği?) sorarak bu çözümü hazırlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Sourdough breadmaking is an ancient culinary art that relies on a wild fermentation process rather than commercial baker's yeast. A sourdough 'starter' is a mixture of flour and water that captures wild yeasts and bacteria from the environment. ______. This slow biochemical activity produces lactic acid, giving the sourdough its characteristic tangy flavor and chewy texture.
secenekler: Commercial yeast was developed in the nineteenth century, revolutionizing industrial baking.
Over time, these microorganisms feed on the starch in the flour, releasing carbon dioxide gas.
Sourdough bread is generally considered much easier to digest than ordinary white bread.
Baking bread at home became extremely popular during the recent quarantine periods.
The starter must be fed daily with fresh flour and water to keep the microorganisms alive.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde sourdough mayasının (starter) ortamdan yabani maya ve bakterileri yakalayan un-su karışımı olduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, zamanla bu mikroorganizmaların undaki nişastayla beslenerek karbondioksit salgıladığını söyleyen ve devamındaki yavaş biyokimyasal aktiviteyi (This slow biochemical activity) başlatan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Space debris, or 'space junk,' has become a critical threat to orbital safety and satellite operations in Low Earth Orbit (LEO). Since the launch of Sputnik in 1957, millions of fragments of defunct satellites, rocket stages, and paint flecks have accumulated in space. ______. Even a tiny paint chip traveling at these orbital velocities can severely damage active satellites or the International Space Station.
secenekler: The International Space Station must occasionally perform maneuvers to avoid collisions.
Because there is no air resistance, these objects travel at speeds of up to twenty-eight thousand kilometers per hour.
Scientists are currently developing space nets and laser systems to clear the orbit.
Most space debris eventually falls back into the atmosphere and burns up harmlessly.
Private aerospace companies are launching thousands of new communication satellites daily.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede "at these orbital velocities" (bu yörünge hızlarında) denilerek hız kavramına vurgu yapılmıştır. Boşluğa, hava direnci olmadığı için bu nesnelerin saatte 28.000 kilometreye varan hızlarla (speeds of up to twenty-eight thousand kilometers per hour) hareket ettiğini söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: For decades, feathers were considered a unique characteristic of modern birds. However, spectacular fossil discoveries over the last thirty years have shattered this view. ______. These primitive feathers were not used for flight, but likely served as insulation to keep the animals warm or as colorful displays to attract mates.
secenekler: Archaeopteryx is widely considered the oldest known fossil linking dinosaurs to birds.
It turns out that many species of non-avian dinosaurs were actually covered in feathers.
Paleontologists rely on advanced chemical analysis to detect melanin pigments in fossils.
The transition from dinosaurs to modern birds occurred during the late Cretaceous period.
Most bird species rely on feathers for aerodynamics, waterproofing, and camouflage.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde tüylerin sadece kuşlara özgü olduğu inanışının yıkıldığından bahsedilmiştir. Boşluğa, kuş olmayan birçok dinozor türünün aslında tüylerle kaplı olduğunun ortaya çıktığını (non-avian dinosaurs were actually covered in feathers) söyleyen ve devamındaki "These primitive feathers" (Bu ilkel tüyler) ifadesini tamamlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: While the placebo effect in humans is well-documented, veterinary scientists have discovered that animals can also experience a similar phenomenon. Known as 'placebo by proxy,' this response is heavily driven by the owner's behavior and expectations. ______. Because the owner believes the treatment is working, they behave more warmly and offer better care, which physically lowers the animal's stress levels.
secenekler: Dogs are highly sensitive to human facial expressions and can identify emotions easily.
Specifically, a pet's health often improves because they respond to the positive mood shift of their owner.
Veterinary clinics must use double-blind trials when testing new medication for pets.
Some animals show signs of recovery even when given completely inactive sugar pills.
Treating chronic pain in elderly cats requires a combination of physical therapy and medication.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde hayvanlardaki plasebo etkisinin (placebo by proxy) sahibinin davranış ve beklentileriyle yönlendirildiği belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, evcil hayvanın sahibindeki olumlu ruh hali değişimine tepki verdiği için sağlığının düzeldiğini (pet's health... improves because they respond to the positive mood shift...) açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Behistun Inscription, carved high on a cliff in western Iran, was the crucial key to deciphering cuneiform writing, the world's oldest script. Written in three different languages—Old Persian, Elamite, and Babylonian—it describes the conquests of King Darius I. ______. By comparing the known Old Persian text with the mysterious Babylonian symbols, scholar Henry Rawlinson cracked the cuneiform code in the 1840s.
secenekler: Cuneiform was originally invented by the Sumerians in Mesopotamia around thirty-two hundred BC.
This trilingual inscription acted as the Rosetta Stone of the ancient Middle East.
King Darius the First ruled the vast Achaemenid Empire during its golden age.
Carving the inscription on a cliff face was intended to protect it from vandals and invaders.
Ancient Babylonian tablets contain some of the earliest recorded mathematical calculations.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde Behistun Yazıtı'nın üç farklı dilde (trilingual) yazıldığı ve çivi yazısının (cuneiform) şifresini çözmede kilit rol oynadığı belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu üç dilli yazıtın antik Orta Doğu'nun Rosetta Taşı (Rosetta Stone of the ancient Middle East) işlevi gördüğünü söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) is a highly discussed technology designed to mitigate global warming by capturing carbon dioxide emissions from industrial factories. Once captured, the CO2 gas is compressed into a liquid state. ______. Geologists target deep, stable rock formations, such as depleted oil reservoirs, to ensure the carbon remains trapped forever.
secenekler: Industrial factories contribute up to forty percent of global greenhouse gas emissions.
It is then transported via pipelines and injected deep underground for permanent storage.
The cost of building and operating CCS facilities is still extremely high for companies.
Some environmentalists argue that CCS is a temporary distraction from renewable energy.
Carbon dioxide can react with minerals in basalt rock to turn into solid stone over time.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde karbondioksitin yakalanıp sıvı hale sıkıştırıldığı (compressed into a liquid state) belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "It is then..." (Ardından o...) geçişiyle bu sıvının boru hatlarıyla taşınarak kalıcı depolama için yerin derinliklerine enjekte edildiğini (injected deep underground...) söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The psychology of impulse buying has been extensively studied by marketing experts seeking to influence consumer behavior. Studies show that impulse buying is rarely driven by logical need, but is instead an emotional response. ______. Retailers exploit this emotional driver by placing bright, cheap products directly next to the checkout registers, where decision fatigue is highest.
secenekler: E-commerce websites use personalized algorithms to suggest products based on browsing history.
Specifically, purchasing a new item triggers a temporary surge of dopamine, creating instant happiness.
Most consumers feel a sense of guilt and financial regret shortly after making an impulse purchase.
Setting a strict monthly budget is the most effective way to prevent unnecessary spending.
Decision fatigue occurs when people are forced to make too many choices in a short period.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde dürtüsel alışverişin mantıksal bir ihtiyaçtan ziyade duygusal bir tepki (emotional response) olduğu söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, bu durumu "Specifically" (Özellikle) diyerek açan ve yeni bir ürün satın almanın beyinde dopamin salgısı tetikleyerek anlık mutluluk yarattığını söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: During reading, our eyes do not move smoothly across the page, but instead make a series of rapid, jerky jumps known as 'saccades.' Between these jumps, the eyes pause briefly for a fraction of a second to process the text. ______. This cognitive coordination reveals that reading is not a passive activity, but a highly active neurological construction.
secenekler: Reading speed can be significantly improved through regular training and eye exercises.
These brief pauses, called fixations, are when the brain actually absorbs the meaning of words.
Some dyslexic readers have difficulty coordinating their saccadic eye movements properly.
The fovea is the central part of the retina responsible for sharp, detailed vision.
Most adults can read between two hundred and three hundred words per minute.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde gözlerin okuma esnasında kısa süreliğine durakladığından (pause briefly) bahsedilmiştir. Boşluğa, "These brief pauses..." (Bu kısa duraklamalar...) diyerek bu duraklamaları "fixations" (fiksasyonlar) olarak tanımlayan ve beynin kelimelerin anlamını burada emdiğini söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The evolutionary domestication of dogs from wolves represents one of the most successful inter-species partnerships in history. While wolves are highly suspicious of humans, dogs possess an innate ability to read human social cues. ______. Over thousands of years, humans selected and bred only the most cooperative animals, gradually altering their genetics and behavior.
secenekler: Dogs were first domesticated during the last Ice Age, at least fifteen thousand years ago.
This social intelligence is not a random accident, but the result of selective breeding.
Wolves rely on complex vocalizations and pack hierarchy to coordinate cooperative hunting.
Some dog breeds retain wolf-like physical characteristics, such as thick fur and pointed ears.
The genetic difference between modern domestic dogs and grey wolves is less than one percent.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde köpeklerin insan sosyal ipuçlarını okuma konusundaki doğuştan gelen yetenekleri (innate ability to read human social cues) vurgulanmıştır. Boşluğa, bu sosyal zekanın (This social intelligence) rastlantısal bir kaza olmadığını, seçici yetiştirmenin (selective breeding) bir sonucu olduğunu belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Bioluminescent bays, such as those found in Puerto Rico, are breathtaking natural wonders that glow in the dark when disturbed. This magical blue-green light is produced by millions of microscopic organisms called dinoflagellates. ______. When a swimmer or a boat moves through the water, the mechanical stress triggers a chemical reaction inside these cells, releasing a flash of light.
secenekler: Dinoflagellates are a type of single-celled algae that live in warm tropical waters.
Interestingly, this glowing effect is actually a defensive mechanism intended to startle predators.
Marine pollution and coastal development are threatening these fragile bioluminescent ecosystems.
The chemical reaction involves a pigment called luciferin and an highly active enzyme.
Most tourists visit these bays during new moon nights when the sky is completely dark.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde körfezdeki mavi-yeşil ışığın mikroskobik dinoflagellat hücreleri tarafından üretildiği belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, ilginç bir şekilde bu parlama etkisinin yırtıcıları korkutmayı amaçlayan bir savunma mekanizması (defensive mechanism) olduğunu açıklayan ve anlam bütünlüğünü derinleştiren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Before the invention of metal coinage, early human societies relied on the barter system to exchange physical goods. While barter worked well in small communities, it became highly impractical as trade expanded across larger regions. ______. Around the seventh century BC, the Kingdom of Lydia, in modern-day Turkey, solved this issue by issuing the world's first standardized metal coins.
secenekler: Silver and gold were highly valued for jewelry and religious statues in ancient times.
Specifically, it required a 'coincidence of wants,' where both parties wanted what the other offered.
Lydian coins were stamped with a lion's head, representing the official authority of the king.
The rise of international trade networks necessitated the creation of credit and banking systems.
Barter is still occasionally used today during severe economic crises or hyperinflation.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde takas (barter) sisteminin ticaret genişledikçe kullanışsız (impractical) hale geldiği söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, bu kullanışsızlığın temel nedenini "Specifically" (Özellikle) diyerek açıklayan ve her iki tarafın da diğerinin sunduğu şeyi istemesi zorunluluğundan (coincidence of wants) bahseden B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Crowdsourcing in scientific research, often called 'citizen science,' has revolutionized how massive data sets are analyzed. By opening projects to the public, professional researchers can utilize the collective brainpower of thousands of volunteers. ______. Thanks to this global volunteer network, projects that would normally take decades to complete are finished in weeks.
secenekler: Citizen science projects often involve monitoring local bird populations or cataloging stars.
These ordinary citizens participate by identifying patterns in images, transcribing documents, or collecting samples.
Professional scientists must ensure that the data collected by volunteers is highly accurate.
Online platforms like Zooniverse host hundreds of crowdsourced research projects globally.
Most volunteers are highly motivated by a personal interest in science and a desire to help.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde araştırmacıların binlerce gönüllünün (volunteers) kolektif beyin gücünden yararlandığı söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, bu sıradan vatandaşların (These ordinary citizens) görüntülerdeki kalıpları belirleyerek veya numune toplayarak projeye nasıl katıldıklarını açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Epigenetics is a revolutionary field of genetics that studies how environmental factors can change gene expression without altering the DNA sequence. External influences like diet, stress, and sleep can attach chemical tags to our genes, turning them on or off. ______. Crucially, some of these epigenetic changes can be passed down to future generations, affecting their health.
secenekler: The human genome contains approximately twenty thousand protein-coding genes.
This means that while our genetic blueprint is fixed, how our body reads it is highly flexible.
Identical twins have the exact same DNA sequence but often develop different health issues.
Epigenetic therapies are currently being developed to reverse cancer gene activation.
Most genetic mutations are caused by environmental radiation or chemical exposure.
aciklama: Beslenme ve stres gibi çevresel faktörlerin DNA dizilimini değiştirmeden genlerin çalışma şeklini değiştirebildiği (turning them on or off) belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "genetik taslağımız sabit olsa da vücudumuzun bunu okuma şeklinin son derece esnek olduğu" (how our body reads it is highly flexible) anlamına geldiğini açıklayan B seçeneği yerleşmelidir.

soru_metni: The subconscious power of smell is increasingly being exploited by marketing experts through a strategy known as 'scent branding.' Human olfaction is directly connected to the limbic system, the brain region responsible for memory and emotion. ______. By releasing signature scents in retail stores, hotels, and airlines, businesses aim to create deep, positive emotional associations with their brand.
secenekler: The human nose can distinguish between more than one trillion different scent molecules.
Consequently, specific scents can instantly trigger vivid childhood memories and emotional states.
Scent branding is highly expensive to implement because it requires specialized ventilation systems.
Some people are highly sensitive to artificial fragrances, experiencing headaches and allergies.
Most consumers are completely unaware that their purchasing choices are influenced by smell.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde koku duyusunun hafıza ve duygulardan sorumlu limbik sistemle doğrudan bağlantılı olduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Consequently" (Sonuç olarak) geçişiyle belirli kokuların çocukluk anılarını ve duygusal durumları anında tetikleyebildiğini söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Black Sea is home to some of the world's best-preserved ancient shipwrecks, dating back thousands of years. Wooden ships that would normally decay within decades remain almost perfectly intact on the sea floor. ______. Because oxygen cannot penetrate these deep waters, the wood-boring bacteria that typically consume timber cannot survive.
secenekler: Marine archaeologists have discovered over sixty ancient shipwrecks in the region recently.
This extraordinary preservation is due to the unique anoxic conditions of the sea's deep layers.
The Black Sea was a major trade route connecting ancient Rome, Greece, and Byzantine empires.
Wooden shipwrecks in shallow waters are rapidly destroyed by wave action and marine life.
Advanced robotic submarines are required to photograph and map these deep shipwrecks safely.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra oksijenin derin sulara nüfuz edememesinden (oxygen cannot penetrate...) bahsedilerek bunun koruyucu etkisi açıklanmıştır. Boşluğa, bu olağanüstü korumanın denizin derin katmanlarındaki benzersiz oksijensiz (anoxic) koşullardan kaynaklandığını belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Historically, human sleep patterns were not always monophasic, meaning one solid block of eight hours. Before the invention of electric lighting, 'segmented sleep' was highly common across Europe. ______. During this midnight waking interval, which lasted an hour or two, people read, prayed, or conversed with family.
secenekler: Most modern doctors recommend maintaining a strict, consistent sleep schedule daily.
Specifically, individuals slept in two distinct phases: first sleep, followed by a period of quiet wakefulness.
Segmented sleep is still practiced by some indigenous tribes in rural South America today.
The invention of the light bulb in the late nineteenth century completely altered human biological clocks.
Chronic sleep deprivation is linked to severe cognitive decline and metabolic disorders.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde geçmişte bölünmüş uykunun (segmented sleep) yaygın olduğu söylenmiş, boşluk sonrasında ise "gece yarısı uyanık kalınan bu dönemde" (During this midnight waking interval) insanların okuyup dua ettikleri belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu durumu "Özellikle, bireyler iki farklı aşamada uyurlardı: ilk uyku ve ardından gelen sessiz uyanıklık dönemi" diyerek açan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Soil erosion is a severe environmental threat that depletes agricultural fertility and damages local ecosystems. Traditional farming practices, such as intensive tilling, leave the soil exposed to wind and rain. ______. By planting cover crops and reducing tillage, farmers can naturally rebuild organic matter and prevent the precious topsoil from washing away.
secenekler: Topsoil contains the highest concentration of organic matter and essential nutrients for plants.
To combat this, regenerative agriculture focus on methods that protect and restore soil structure.
Agricultural runoff is a major contributor to water pollution in nearby rivers and lakes.
The Dust Bowl of the 1930s in the United States was a classic example of severe soil erosion.
Most chemical fertilizers only provide temporary nutrients without restoring the soil's natural biology.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde yoğun toprak işlemenin toprağı rüzgar ve yağmura karşı korumasız bıraktığı ve erozyona yol açtığı belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "To combat this" (Bununla mücadele etmek için) geçişiyle koruyucu tarım yöntemlerine değinen ve devamindeki örtücü bitki ekimiyle (planting cover crops) örtüşen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Hydroponics and aeroponics are advanced soil-less agricultural technologies that are reshaping urban farming. While hydroponics involves growing plants in a nutrient-rich water solution, aeroponics takes a different approach. ______. This misting method allows the roots to absorb maximum oxygen, leading to significantly faster growth rates.
secenekler: Urban cities are increasingly utilizing abandoned warehouses for vertical agricultural projects.
In aeroponic systems, the roots of the plants are suspended in the air and misted with nutrients.
Hydroponics requires a continuous circulation of water to prevent algae growth and root rot.
Both methods use up to ninety percent less water than traditional soil-based agriculture.
Some crops, like potatoes and carrots, are highly difficult to grow using soil-less technologies.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde hidroponiğin kökleri besinli suda tuttuğu, aeroponiğin ise farklı bir yaklaşım izlediği belirtilmiştir. Boşluktan hemen sonra gelen "This misting method" (Bu sisleme yöntemi) ifadesini açıklayan ve köklerin havada asılı tutularak besin sisiyle beslendiğini anlatan B seçeneği akışı tamamlar.

soru_metni: In behavioral economics, 'nudge theory' proposes that positive reinforcement and indirect suggestions can influence human choices more effectively than laws. Instead of banning unhealthy habits, nudges gently alter the choice architecture. ______. This simple rearrangement naturally encourages healthier eating choices without restricting any individual freedom.
secenekler: The theory was popularized by Nobel laureate Richard Thaler and legal scholar Cass Sunstein.
For example, placing fresh fruit at eye level in a cafeteria is a classic nudge.
Some critics argue that nudge theory can be used by governments to manipulate citizens.
Traditional economic models assume that human beings always make perfectly rational decisions.
Tax incentives are often considered a more direct and powerful way to change behavior.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasında "This simple rearrangement..." (Bu basit yeniden düzenleme...) denilerek fiziksel bir düzen değişikliğine atıfta bulunulmuştur. Boşluğa, kafeteryada taze meyveleri göz hizasına yerleştirme örneğini sunarak bu düzen değişikliğini açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The discovery of penicillin by Alexander Fleming in nineteen twenty-eight revolutionized modern medicine and marked the birth of antibiotics. Returning from a vacation, Fleming noticed that a green mold had contaminated one of his petri dishes. ______. He identified the mold as Penicillium notatum and realized it produced a substance capable of killing deadly bacterial pathogens.
secenekler: Bacterial infections were the leading cause of death globally before the twentieth century.
Remarkably, the bacteria immediately surrounding the mold had been completely destroyed.
Fleming shared the nineteen forty-five Nobel Prize in Medicine with Howard Florey and Ernst Chain.
Pharmaceutical companies struggled for years to mass-produce penicillin during World War II.
Today, the overuse of antibiotics is leading to the dangerous rise of drug-resistant superbugs.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde Fleming'in laboratuvara döndüğünde yeşil bir küfün (green mold) petri kabını kirlettiğini fark ettiği belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Remarkably" (Dikkat çekici bir şekilde) diyerek küfün etrafındaki bakterilerin tamamen yok olduğunu söyleyen ve devamindeki Fleming'in bu maddeyi (Penicillium) tanımlamasını hazırlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: While the impact of microplastics on oceans is widely studied, scientists are now focusing on their devastating effects on soil ecosystems. These microscopic plastic fragments are ingested by earthworms, which are vital for maintaining soil health. ______. Consequently, the soil becomes compacted and nutrient-depleted, severely harming crop growth and agricultural productivity.
secenekler: Most microplastics in agricultural soil come from plastic mulching films and sewage sludge.
Specifically, plastic accumulation weakens the worms, reducing their ability to burrow and aerate the soil.
Earthworms play a crucial role in decomposing organic matter and recycling vital nutrients.
Scientists are currently developing biodegradable alternatives to prevent soil plastic pollution.
Microplastics can absorb toxic chemicals from the surrounding environment, increasing their toxicity.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde mikroplastiklerin toprak sağlığı için hayati olan solucanlar (earthworms) tarafından yutulduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Specifically" (Özellikle) diyerek bu durumun solucanların toprağı kazma ve havalandırma yeteneklerini (burrow and aerate the soil) zayıflattığını söyleyen ve devamindeki toprağın sıkışması (compacted soil) sonucunu bağlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The House of Wisdom, established in Baghdad during the Islamic Golden Age, was a monumental center of learning and translation. Scholars from diverse cultures and religions gathered there to translate ancient Greek, Persian, and Indian texts into Arabic. ______. This massive preservation effort saved thousands of philosophical and scientific works that would otherwise have been lost to history.
secenekler: Baghdad was the capital of the Abbasid Caliphate and a major trading hub in the Middle East.
Specifically, they translated key works by Aristotle, Plato, and mathematician Euclid.
The institution was unfortunately completely destroyed during the Mongol siege of Baghdad in twelve fifty-eight.
Paper production technology imported from China greatly facilitated the translation and copying process.
Many European scholars traveled to Spain and Sicily to translate these Arabic texts into Latin.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde çeşitli kültürlerden bilginlerin eski Yunanca, Farsça ve Hintçe metinleri Arapçaya çevirmek için toplandıkları belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Specifically" (Özellikle) diyerek Aristo, Platon ve Öklid gibi düşünürlerin önemli eserlerini çevirdiklerini detaylandıran B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Urban heat islands occur when cities replace natural vegetation with concrete and asphalt, raising local temperatures. To mitigate this effect, many modern cities are investing heavily in 'green roofs.' ______. By absorbing solar radiation and evaporating water, these rooftop plants can lower building temperatures and reduce air conditioning energy use.
secenekler: Concrete and asphalt absorb significantly more solar heat than soil and vegetation.
These are rooftops covered with living vegetation and soil layers instead of traditional tiles.
Green roofs can also capture rainwater, reducing the risk of urban flooding during heavy storms.
The cost of installing and maintaining a green roof is still a major barrier for property owners.
Many European cities are offering financial subsidies to encourage green roof construction.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde şehirlerin sıcaklığı düşürmek için "green roofs" (yeşil çatılar) uygulamasına yatırım yaptığı söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, "These are..." (Bunlar...) diyerek yeşil çatıların ne olduğunu (geleneksel kiremitler yerine bitki ve toprak katmanlarıyla kaplı çatılar) açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Great Vowel Shift, occurring between the fourteenth and seventeenth centuries, was a major phonetic change in the history of the English language. During this period, the pronunciation of all long vowels in Middle English was systematically altered. ______. This historical gap explains why English spelling often seems highly inconsistent and confusing to modern learners.
secenekler: The shift was highly influenced by the social changes following the Black Death pandemic.
However, because the spelling of words had already been standardized by early printing presses, spelling did not change with pronunciation.
Most dialects of modern English still retain some vowel pronunciations from the medieval era.
Linguists utilize historical manuscripts to trace the gradual evolution of vowel sounds over time.
Middle English was heavily influenced by French vocabulary following the Norman Conquest of ten sixty-six.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede "This historical gap..." (Bu tarihsel boşluk/uyumsuzluk...) denilerek İngilizce yazım kurallarının (spelling) neden kafa karıştırıcı olduğu açıklanmıştır. Boşluğa, telaffuz değişirken matbaanın etkisiyle yazım standartlarının sabit kalması nedeniyle bu uyumsuzluğun oluştuğunu belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Artificial intelligence (AI) has dramatically improved the accuracy and speed of global weather forecasting. Traditional forecasting models rely on solving complex physical equations, requiring immense supercomputing power. ______. By analyzing decades of historical climate data in seconds, these neural networks can predict storms, heatwaves, and rainfall with unprecedented speed.
secenekler: Weather forecasting is highly vital for agriculture, aviation, and disaster management.
AI models, in contrast, utilize deep learning to identify patterns in historical weather events.
Supercomputers are still necessary to run high-resolution global climate simulations.
Extreme weather events are becoming much more frequent and severe due to global climate change.
Some meteorologists are concerned that AI will eventually replace human weather analysts entirely.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde geleneksel tahmin modellerinin karmaşık fizik denklemlerini çözmeye dayandığı belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "in contrast" (buna karşın) geçişiyle yapay zeka modellerinin derin öğrenme (deep learning) yoluyla geçmiş hava olaylarındaki kalıpları belirleme yaklaşımını anlatan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Mirror neurons are a unique class of brain cells that fire both when an individual performs an action and when they watch someone else perform the same action. Discovered in monkeys in the nineteen nineties, they are believed to exist in the human brain as well. ______. By mentally simulating the actions and feelings of others, we can intuitively understand their intentions and experience empathy.
secenekler: The discovery was made by a team of Italian neuroscientists led by Giacomo Rizzolatti.
Many neuroscientists suggest that these cells form the neurological foundation of human empathy.
Mirror neuron deficits have been linked to social difficulties in some clinical studies.
Watching a professional athlete can trigger minor muscle activation in the viewer's own body.
Most cognitive theories assume that empathy is a learned social skill rather than a biological trait.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede "By mentally simulating..." (Başkalarının eylem ve duygularını zihinsel olarak simüle ederek...) empati deneyimlediğimiz anlatılmıştır. soru_metni: Unlike classical computers, which process information in bits of 0s and 1s, quantum computers utilize quantum bits, or qubits. secenekler: Classical computers remain much cheaper to manufacture and maintain for ordinary businesses.
This unique physical state enables them to process multiple computational pathways at the exact same time.
Most modern software applications are completely incompatible with quantum processing architectures.
Physicists must cool quantum processors to temperatures colder than deep space to keep them stable.
The global race to build the first commercially viable quantum computer is accelerating rapidly.

soru_metni: The architectural design of Gothic cathedrals in medieval Europe was a revolutionary engineering achievement. To build much taller stone walls with massive stained-glass windows, architects had to solve the problem of lateral thrust. ______. These external arched supports safely channeled the immense weight of the roof away from the walls and down to the ground.
secenekler: Cathedrals were primarily funded by wealthy local merchants and religious donations.
To achieve this, they developed a brilliant structural innovation known as the flying buttress.
Most medieval builders were completely illiterate and relied entirely on practical experience.
The transition from Romanesque to Gothic architecture occurred during the late twelfth century.
Stained-glass windows frequently depicted complex biblical stories for the illiterate public.

Boşluğa, bunu başarmak için (To achieve this) "flying buttress" (uçan payanda) adı verilen parlak bir yapısal yenilik geliştirdiklerini açıklayan ve devamındaki "these external arched supports" (bu dış kemerli destekler) ifadesine zemin hazırlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The orchid mantis is one of the most stunning examples of aggressive mimicry in the animal kingdom. Found in the tropical rainforests of Southeast Asia, its body closely resembles a beautiful orchid flower. ______. Unsuspecting insects flying by mistake the mantis for a harmless petal, only to be captured in a split-second strike.
secenekler: Most mantis species rely on simple green or brown camouflage to hide from predators.
This remarkable resemblance is not for hiding, but is instead used actively to lure prey.
Male orchid mantises are significantly smaller than females and rarely engage in hunting.
Rainforest ecosystems are highly famous for their extremely dense and complex biodiversity.
Some predatory birds have developed highly specialized vision to detect camouflaged insects.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce orkide peygamberdevesinin vücudunun bir orkide çiçeğine çok benzediği belirtilmiştir. Boşluktan sonra ise avı olan böceklerin onu zararsız bir taç yaprağı sanıp yakalandığı anlatılmaktadır. Boşluğa, bu dikkat çekici benzerliğin gizlenmek için olmadığını, aksine aktif olarak avı çekmek için kullanıldığını belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Great Pacific Garbage Patch is a massive accumulation of marine debris located in the North Pacific Ocean. It is not a solid island of plastic, as many mistakenly believe, but rather a thick soup of microplastics. ______. These rotating currents draw plastic waste from coastlines across the globe, trapping it in a permanent vortex.
secenekler: Most plastic waste in the ocean consists of single-use water bottles and shopping bags.

Marine biologists are highly concerned about the toxic chemicals released by degrading plastic.
Cleaning up the garbage patch is extremely difficult because of its vast geographic size.
Several non-profit organizations are currently developing massive floating ocean cleanup systems.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra "These rotating currents..." (Bu dönen akıntılar...) denilerek akıntılardan bahsedilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu birikimin temel sebebinin "gyre" adı verilen dairesel okyanus akıntıları sistemi (circular ocean currents) olduğunu belirterek "dönen akıntılar" ifadesine referans veren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: For decades, scientists believed that the adult human brain was a rigid, unchangeable organ. However, the discovery of neuroplasticity has completely transformed modern neuroscience. Neuroplasticity is the brain's ability to reorganize itself by forming new neural connections throughout life. ______. This adaptability explains how stroke patients can relearn lost skills by training alternative brain regions.
secenekler: The brain consists of approximately eighty-six billion specialized cells called neurons.
This means that the brain remains highly flexible, changing in response to learning or injury.
Most age-related cognitive decline is caused by the gradual loss of neural connections.
Learning a foreign language is one of the most effective ways to stimulate brain activity.
Brain imaging technology has allowed scientists to observe these changes in real-time.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce nöroplastisitenin beynin yaşam boyunca yeni sinirsel bağlantılar kurarak kendini yeniden organize etme yeteneği olduğu söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, "This means that..." (Bu demektir ki...) diyerek beynin öğrenme veya yaralanmalara yanıt olarak son derece esnek kaldığını (highly flexible) açıklayan ve devamindeki felç hastalarının alternatif bölgeleri eğiterek becerileri yeniden kazanması örneğini (This adaptability) destekleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Challenger Deep, located at the southern end of the Mariana Trench, is the deepest known point in the Earth's oceans. At nearly eleven thousand meters below the surface, it is a realm of absolute darkness and freezing temperatures. ______. To survive this crushing environment, deep-sea vessels must be constructed using extremely thick titanium hulls.
secenekler: Most deep-sea organisms are completely blind and rely on chemical senses to navigate.
Furthermore, the water pressure at this depth is an incredible one thousand times greater than at sea level.
The first manned descent into the trench was made by Jacques Piccard and Don Walsh in 1960.
Surprisingly, scientists have discovered several species of microscopic bacteria thriving in the mud.
Oceanographic research is highly expensive and requires specialized scientific research ships.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonraki cümlede "To survive this crushing environment" (Bu ezici çevre koşullarında hayatta kalmak için) ifadesi kullanılarak yüksek basınca atıfta bulunulmuştur. Boşluğa, "Furthermore" (Dahası) geçişiyle su basıncının deniz seviyesinden 1000 kat daha fazla olduğunu belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In behavioral economics, the 'endowment effect' is a cognitive bias where people value things more highly merely because they own them. In classic experiments, participants who were given a coffee mug refused to sell it for less than twice the price that buyers were willing to pay. ______. This irrational behavior directly contradicts traditional economic theories, which assume people make objective decisions.
secenekler: Most financial advisors recommend keeping a diverse investment portfolio to manage risks.
This happens because the pain of losing an item is psychologically stronger than the pleasure of gaining it.
The effect was first coined by Nobel laureate Richard Thaler during his behavioral studies.
Some marketing campaigns exploit this bias by offering risk-free money-back guarantees.
Cognitive biases are highly common and affect several aspects of daily human decision-making.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce endowment etkisinin (sahiplik etkisi) ne olduğu ve yapılan kahve bardağı deneyi anlatılmıştır. Boşluğa, bu durumun nedenini açıklayan; bir şeyi kaybetmenin acısının onu kazanmanın hazzından psikolojik olarak daha güçlü olduğunu söyleyen (loss aversion bağlantısı) B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The creation of Esperanto in the late nineteenth century was an ambitious linguistic experiment. Designed by L. L. Zamenhof, its goal was to serve as an easy-to-learn, politically neutral international second language. ______. Despite Zamenhof's noble intentions, English eventually emerged as the global lingua franca, leaving Esperanto as a niche hobby.
secenekler: Esperanto has a highly systematic grammar with absolutely no irregular verbs.
He hoped that a shared common language would foster global peace and understanding.
The vocabulary of Esperanto is derived primarily from Romance and Germanic languages.
Most traditional linguists were highly skeptical of artificial languages during that period.
Today, there are estimated to be around two million Esperanto speakers worldwide.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce Esperanto dilinin L. L. Zamenhof tarafından kolay öğrenilen ve sivil veya siyasi açıdan tarafsız bir uluslararası ortak ikinci dil olması için tasarlandığı söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, Zamenhof'un amacını "He hoped that..." (Umut ediyordu ki...) diyerek açan ve ortak dilin küresel barışa (global peace) katkı sağlayacağını umduğunu belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The El Niño Southern Oscillation (ENSO) is a powerful climate pattern that involves temperature fluctuations in the tropical Pacific Ocean. During an El Niño phase, unusually warm ocean waters accumulate along the coast of South America. ______. Consequently, some regions experience devastating floods, while others suffer from historic droughts.
secenekler: The phenomenon occurs periodically, typically repeating every two to seven years.
This warm water alters global atmospheric circulation, dramatically disrupting worldwide weather systems.
In contrast, La Niña is characterized by unusually cold sea surface temperatures.
Meteorologists utilize advanced satellite networks to track ocean surface temperatures.
Agriculture is highly sensitive to the sudden weather shifts caused by ENSO phases.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde El Niño evresinde Güney Amerika kıyılarında alışılmadık derecede sıcak suların biriktiği belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu sıcak suların küresel atmosfer sirkülasyonunu değiştirdiğini ve dünya çapındaki hava sistemlerini bozduğunu söyleyen ve devamındaki sel/kuraklık felaketlerini (devastating floods/droughts) gerekçelendiren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The 'bystander effect' is a well-known social psychological phenomenon where individuals are less likely to offer help to a victim when other people are present. Researchers suggest that as the number of witnesses increases, the perceived personal responsibility of each individual decreases. ______. Each person assumes that someone else has already called for help or is about to intervene.
secenekler: The phenomenon was first investigated following the tragic murder of Kitty Genovese in 1964.
Specifically, this diffusion of responsibility leads to a collective hesitation to take action.
Psychological training can help individuals overcome this bias and act quickly in emergencies.
Some social experiments have challenged the validity of early bystander effect findings.
In emergency situations, directing a request to a specific person is highly effective.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce tanık sayısı arttıkça kişisel sorumluluk algısının azaldığı (responsibility decreases) söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, "Specifically" (Özellikle) diyerek bu sorumluluk dağılımının (diffusion of responsibility) kolektif bir tereddüde yol açtığını belirten ve devamındaki "herkes başkasının yardım çağırdığını varsayar" açıklamasıyla örtüşen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The discovery of the Periodic Table of Elements by Dmitri Mendeleev in eighteen sixty-nine was a turning point in chemistry. Instead of simply listing the known elements, Mendeleev organized them based on their atomic mass and chemical properties. ______. Mendeleev confidently left blank spaces in his table, predicting the existence and properties of elements that had not yet been discovered.
secenekler: At the time, only about sixty-three chemical elements were known to science.
By doing this, he realized that certain chemical behaviors repeated in a predictable pattern.
Mendeleev was a Russian chemist and professor at Saint Petersburg State University.

German chemist Julius Lothar Meyer developed a highly similar table at the same time.

(Bunu yaparak...) geçişiyle belirli kimyasal davranışların öngörülebilir bir düzende tekrar ettiğini fark ettiğini belirten ve devamındaki henüz keşfedilmemiş elementlerin özelliklerini tahmin edebilmesini (predicting... properties) açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In the ancient Mediterranean world, the Library of Pergamum was the primary rival to the great Library of Alexandria. Located in modern-day Turkey, Pergamum's collection grew so rapidly that the rulers of Egypt felt highly threatened. ______. In response, Pergamum developed 'parchment' made from animal skins as an highly durable alternative writing material.

Most ancient libraries were destroyed by accidental fires during military invasions.
Mark Antony famously gifted the entire Pergamum collection to Cleopatra after Alexandria burned.
