This physical response demonstrates that belief and expectation can directly alter cardiovascular efficiency.
secenekler: Professional sports organizations must use double-blind drug testing to detect illegal substances.
Remarkably, their bodies actually consumed less oxygen and produced less lactic acid during workouts.
Some athletes suffer from severe pre-game anxiety, which can negatively impact their results.
Endurance training requires a combination of high-intensity workouts and proper nutrition plans.
Most sports supplements sold online do not have any scientific proof backing their claims.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce sporculara oksijen takviyesi sanılarak plasebo (şeker hapı) verildiği ve dayanıklılıklarının arttığı söylenmiştir. Boşluktan sonra ise "This physical response" (Bu fiziksel tepki) denilerek kalbe/akciğere dayalı bir verimliliğe değinilmiştir. Boşluğa, vücutlarının antrenman esnasında "daha az oksijen tükettiğini ve daha az laktik asit ürettiğini" belirterek bu fiziksel tepkiyi somutlaştıran B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The invention of the telescope in the early seventeenth century fundamentally transformed our understanding of the universe. While German-Dutch spectacle-maker Hans Lippershey is often credited with the earliest design in 1608, it was Galileo Galilei who first utilized the instrument for astronomy. ______. These unexpected discoveries shattered the traditional geocentric model, proving that the cosmos was much more dynamic.
secenekler: Lippershey's original device used a convex objective lens and a concave eyepiece lens.
By pointing his telescope at the night sky, Galileo discovered the moons of Jupiter and sunspots.
Most astronomers during the Renaissance believed that the Earth was the center of the universe.
The Catholic Church heavily criticized Galileo for supporting the heliocentric theory of Copernicus.
Modern refracting telescopes rely on highly advanced mirror systems instead of glass lenses.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce Galileo'nun bu aleti astronomide kullanan ilk kişi olduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluktan hemen sonra gelen "These unexpected discoveries" (Bu beklenmedik keşifler) ifadesini açıklayan; Galileo'nun teleskobunu gökyüzüne çevirerek Jüpiter'in uydularını ve güneş lekelerini keşfettiğini söyleyen B seçeneği anlam akışını tamamlar.

soru_metni: The Sahel region of Africa, a transition zone between the Sahara Desert and the southern savannas, is facing a severe crisis of desertification. Overuse of agricultural land, combined with climate-induced droughts, has stripped the soil of vegetation. ______. Consequently, the fragile topsoil is easily blown away by strong desert winds, leaving behind an infertile wasteland.
secenekler: Many international aid organizations are currently distributing food to rural villages in Chad.
Without plants to anchor the soil, the land loses its natural moisture and structural integrity.
The Great Green Wall is an highly ambitious initiative to plant millions of trees across Africa.
Traditional nomadic herders in the region rely on goats and cattle for their daily livelihood.
The Sahara Desert is expanding southward at an average rate of several kilometers per year.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde tarım arazilerinin aşırı kullanımı ve kuraklığın toprağı bitki örtüsünden yoksun bıraktığı (stripped the soil of vegetation) belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "bitkiler olmadan toprağın nemini ve yapısal bütünlüğünü kaybettiğini" açıklayan ve devamındaki "toprağın rüzgarla kolayca uçup gitmesi" (topsoil is easily blown away) sonucunu gerekçelendiren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has enabled the creation of 'deepfakes'—highly realistic manipulated videos and audio recordings. While the technology has creative applications in the film industry, it also presents severe ethical and security threats. ______. In response, software developers are racing to create advanced verification algorithms that can detect subtle digital manipulations.
secenekler: AI models require massive amounts of processed video and audio data to learn realistic facial movements.
Specifically, deepfakes can be easily weaponized to spread political disinformation and ruin personal reputations.
Most social media platforms have recently implemented strict bans on all AI-generated artwork.
The entertainment industry is investing billions of dollars to digitize deceased actors for movies.
Many computer science departments are offering specialized courses in neural network architectures.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde deepfake videolarının etik ve güvenlik tehditleri (ethical and security threats) oluşturduğu söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, bu tehdidi "Specifically" (Özellikle) diyerek açan; bu teknolojinin siyasi dezenformasyon yaymak ve kişisel itibarları zedelemek için kolayca silah haline getirilebileceğini (weaponized) söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In cognitive psychology, 'confirmation bias' is the tendency to search for, interpret, and recall information in a way that confirms one's beliefs. This cognitive bias prevents people from looking at situations objectively, leading to highly polarized views. ______. This psychological filter makes it extremely difficult for individuals to change their minds, even when faced with solid evidence.
secenekler: Most psychologists suggest that self-awareness is the first step to overcoming cognitive biases.
In practice, we naturally ignore or reject any facts that contradict our established opinions.
Social media algorithms often amplify this bias by creating personalized information bubbles.
Traditional scientific research relies on testing hypotheses through rigorous double-blind trials.
Many political debates are highly emotional because participants feel their identity is under threat.
aciklama: Boşluktan önce onaylama önyargısının (confirmation bias) insanların durumlara nesnel bakmasını engellediği belirtilmiştir. Boşluktan hemen sonra gelen "This psychological filter" (Bu psikolojik filtre) ifadesini açıklayan; pratikte kendi görüşlerimizle çelişen tüm gerçekleri doğal olarak görmezden geldiğimizi veya reddettiğimizi belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In the seventeenth century, the rise of coffee houses in London fundamentally transformed the city's social and intellectual life. Known as 'penny universities' because anyone could enter for a penny, they became hubs for lively political debate and news. ______. Unlike traditional taverns, they provided a sober, academic environment where merchants, writers, and scientists could collaborate.
secenekler: Coffee was first imported to Europe from the Ottoman Empire through Venetian trade networks.
This unique social setup successfully democratized the flow of information across different social classes.
The British East India Company strongly opposed the popularity of coffee to protect its tea monopoly.
Many famous writers, such as Jonathan Swift and Alexander Pope, frequently visited these houses.
The government under King Charles the Second briefly banned coffee houses in sixteen seventy-five.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde kahvehanelerin bir kuruş ödeyen herkesin girebildiği canlı tartışma merkezleri (penny universities) olduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu eşsiz sosyal kurulumun (This unique social setup) farklı sosyal sınıflar arasında bilgi akışını demokratikleştirdiğini söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Tardigrades, commonly known as 'water bears,' are microscopic eight-legged animals famous for being almost completely indestructible. When faced with extreme environmental stress, they enter a state called cryptobiosis, expelling almost all water from their bodies. ______. In this dormant state, they can survive freezing space vacuums, extreme radiation, and boiling temperatures.
secenekler: Tardigrades are usually found living in damp moss, pond water, and deep forest soils.
By doing this, they transition into a dry, glass-like state where metabolic activity virtually stops.
Scientists are currently analyzing their DNA sequence to identify genes responsible for radiation resistance.
Most microscopic organisms are highly sensitive to sudden changes in temperature and salinity.
The first tardigrade fossils date back to the Cretaceous period, showing almost zero evolutionary change.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde su ayılarının (tardigrades) çevre baskısı karşısında vücutlarındaki neredeyse tüm suyu dışarı attıkları (expelling almost all water) belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "By doing this" (Bunu yaparak) geçişiyle metabolik faaliyetlerin durduğu cam benzeri kuru bir duruma geçtiklerini açıklayan ve devamındaki ekstrem koşullarda hayatta kalabilme durumunu (dormant state) bağlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Code of Hammurabi, created around 1750 BC in ancient Babylon, is one of the oldest and best-preserved written legal codes in history. Carved onto a massive black basalt slab, the laws were displayed publicly for all citizens to see. ______. By establishing clear, written rules, Hammurabi successfully consolidated his political power and unified his empire.
secenekler: Babylon was the capital of the Amorite dynasty and a major economic hub in Mesopotamia.
The primary objective of this public display was to ensure that justice was uniform across the state.
Most laws in the code relied on the harsh principle of retribution, known as an eye for an eye.
The slab was discovered in 1901 by French archaeologists in the ancient ruins of Susa.
Hammurabi was the sixth king of Babylon, ruling during its highly influential first dynasty.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde Hammurabi Kanunları'nın herkesin görmesi için halka açık bir şekilde sergilendiği (displayed publicly) belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu halka açık sergilemenin temel amacının (The primary objective of this public display) devlet genelinde adaletin tekdüze olmasını sağlamak olduğunu belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Mangrove forests are unique coastal ecosystems that thrive in salty, low-oxygen tropical soils. To survive in these harsh environments, mangrove trees have developed extraordinary evolutionary adaptations. ______. These dense networks of roots also trap sediment and absorb wave energy, protecting coastal communities from devastating erosion.
secenekler: Mangroves provide critical nursery grounds for several commercially important fish and shrimp species.
Specifically, they possess specialized prop roots that arch above the water to absorb vital oxygen.
Many countries have recently implemented strict laws to stop the destruction of mangrove swamps.
Rising global sea levels pose a severe threat to these fragile intertidal ecosystems.
Most mangrove species cannot survive in water temperatures colder than twenty degrees Celsius.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde mangrov ağaçlarının tuzlu ve oksijensiz kıyı topraklarında hayatta kalmak için sıra dışı adaptasyonlar (extraordinary evolutionary adaptations) geliştirdiği söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, "Specifically" (Özellikle) diyerek sudan oksijen almak için suyun üzerine uzanan özel köklerini (prop roots) açıklayan ve devamındaki "these dense networks of roots" (bu yoğun kök ağları) ifadesine doğrudan atıfta bulunan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The transition to clean energy is highly essential for reducing global greenhouse gas emissions and fighting climate change. While solar and wind power are the most widely discussed renewable sources, geothermal energy offers a unique advantage. ______. This constant availability makes geothermal power an highly reliable baseload energy source that can stabilize national electrical grids.
secenekler: Solar panels require massive land areas and are highly expensive to manufacture and recycle.
Unlike solar and wind, geothermal plants can generate clean electricity continuously, twenty-four hours a day.
Iceland generates almost ninety percent of its household heating using geothermal hot water.
Most geothermal reservoirs are located near active volcanic boundaries and fault lines.
Geothermal drilling requires highly specialized technology similar to deep-sea oil exploration.
aciklama: Boşluktan sonra "This constant availability" (Bu sürekli kullanılabilirlik) ifadesi kullanılarak kesintisiz enerji üretimine vurgu yapılmıştır. Boşluğa, güneş ve rüzgarın aksine jeotermal santrallerin 24 saat boyunca kesintisiz temiz elektrik üretebildiğini (continuously, twenty-four hours a day) belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming clinical medicine, particularly in the interpretation of medical imaging. Machine learning models can analyze complex scans, such as MRIs and X-rays, in a fraction of a second. ______. This rapid diagnostic speed allows radiologists to prioritize urgent cases, significantly improving patient survival rates.
secenekler: AI algorithms are trained on massive databases containing millions of anonymized patient scans.
In clinical trials, these algorithms have matched or even exceeded human doctors in detecting tumors.
However, some medical experts are concerned about the legal liability of AI diagnostic errors.
MRI scans are highly expensive to perform and require specialized helium cooling systems.
Many rural clinics suffer from a severe shortage of experienced radiologists and doctors.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde yapay zekanın tıbbi görüntüleri çok hızlı inceleyebildiğinden bahsedilmiş, boşluk sonrasında ise "This rapid diagnostic speed" (Bu hızlı teşhis hızı) denilerek tanı başarısına atıfta bulunulmuştur. Boşluğa, klinik deneylerde bu algoritmaların tümör tespitinde insan doktorları yakaladığını veya geçtiğini (matched or even exceeded human doctors) belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The invention of the destruction force in ninth-century China completely altered the history of human warfare and geopolitics. Originally discovered accidentally by alchemists searching for an elixir of immortality, it was initially used for fireworks. ______. These early weapons quickly spread across the Silk Road to Europe, ending the era of medieval castles and knights.
secenekler: Alchemists used a mixture of sulfur, charcoal, and potassium nitrate to create the explosive powder.
However, military engineers soon realized its destructive power and developed the world's first cannons.
The Song Dynasty successfully kept the secret formula of gunpowder hidden from foreign nations for decades.
Fireworks are still a major part of traditional cultural celebrations in China today.
Most medieval battles in Europe were fought using swords, bows, and heavy wooden trebuchets.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde barutun Çin'de tesadüfen bulunduğu ve ilk başta havai fişek olarak kullanıldığı söylenmiştir. Boşluk sonrasında ise "These early weapons" (Bu erken dönem silahları) ifadesiyle barutun askeri kullanımına geçilmiştir. Boşluğa, "However" (Ancak) diyerek askeri mühendislerin bunun yıkıcı gücünü fark edip ilk topları (cannons) geliştirdiğini anlatan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In psychology, the concept of 'flow state' describes a mental condition where a person is fully immersed in an activity with deep focus and enjoyment. Often referred to as being 'in the zone,' individuals in this state lose all sense of time and self-consciousness. ______. By matching task difficulty with personal skill level, flow naturally boosts performance, leading to peak athletic and artistic achievements.
secenekler: The concept of flow was first defined by psychologist Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi in 1975.
This happens when there is a perfect balance between the challenge of the task and the skills of the individual.
Some people find that listening to classical music helps them enter a deep state of concentration.
Flow state is highly difficult to maintain in modern digital environments filled with notifications.
Most traditional school curricula do not design activities that encourage flow among students.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede "görevin zorluğuyla bireysel beceri düzeyinin eşleştirilmesinden" (matching task difficulty with personal skill level) bahsedilmektedir. Boşluğa, akış durumunun "görevin zorluğu ile bireyin becerileri arasında mükemmel bir denge (perfect balance between the challenge... and the skills) olduğunda gerçekleştiğini" söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Gulf Stream is a powerful, warm ocean current that transports tropical water from the Gulf of Mexico up to the North Atlantic. This current plays an highly critical role in moderating the climate of Western Europe, keeping it significantly warmer than other regions at similar latitudes. ______. If this current collapses, Europe could experience devastating winters and agricultural failures.
secenekler: The current travels at an average speed of about six kilometers per hour near the Florida coast.
However, climate change is melting Arctic ice, releasing fresh water that is slowing down this current.
Marine biologists rely on advanced satellite sensors to monitor sea surface temperatures.
The Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) is the larger system that includes the Gulf Stream.
Some species of migratory fish and turtles utilize ocean currents to travel vast distances.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde Körfez Akıntısı'nın (Gulf Stream) Avrupa iklimini yumuşatan olumlu etkisinden bahsedilmiş, boşluk sonrasında ise "akıntının çökmesi halinde" (If this current collapses) Avrupa'nın felaket kışları yaşayacağı uyarısı yapılmıştır. Akıntının iklim değişikliği nedeniyle yavaşladığını (slowing down this current) belirterek bu tehdidi başlatan B seçeneği aradaki köprüyü kurar.

soru_metni: Before the discovery of insulin in 1921, diagnosing a patient with Type 1 diabetes was essentially a death sentence. Patients, mostly young children, suffered from rapid weight loss, extreme thirst, and eventual organ failure. ______. This miraculous scientific breakthrough, achieved by Frederick Banting and Charles Best, saved millions of lives almost overnight.
secenekler: Diabetes is a metabolic disorder where the body cannot produce or properly use insulin.
The only treatment available at the time was a strict starvation diet that only delayed death by months.
Banting and Best were awarded the Nobel Prize in Medicine in nineteen twenty-three for their discovery.
Today, insulin is manufactured using genetically modified bacteria in massive bioreactor tanks.
Most patients with Type 2 diabetes can manage their symptoms through exercise and diet shifts.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde insülin keşfinden önce diyabetin ölümcül olduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, o dönemdeki tek "tedavinin" ölümü sadece birkaç ay geciktiren çok katı bir açlık diyeti (starvation diet) olduğunu anlatan B seçeneği gelmeli ve ardından gelen insülin keşfinin bu durumu nasıl mucizevi bir şekilde değiştirdiğini (miraculous scientific breakthrough) vurgulamalıdır.

soru_metni: Honeybees play an highly vital role in global agriculture, pollinating about one-third of the crops we consume daily. However, over the last two decades, bee populations have been declining rapidly due to 'colony collapse disorder.' ______. Without bees to pollinate these crops, global food security could face catastrophic shortages and soaring prices.
secenekler: Beekeeping has been practiced since ancient times, particularly in Egypt and Greece.
This mysterious phenomenon occurs when worker bees suddenly abandon their hive, leaving behind the queen.
Pesticides like neonicotinoids are highly suspected of disrupting the navigation systems of bees.
Some bee species live solitary lives in the wild instead of forming massive social colonies.
Many organic farms are creating wild wildflower corridors to attract natural pollinators back.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde arı popülasyonlarının "koloni çöküş bozukluğu" (colony collapse disorder) nedeniyle hızla azaldığı söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, bu gizemli fenomeni (This mysterious phenomenon) "işçi arıların kovanı aniden terk etmesi" olarak açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Atlantic cod fishery off the coast of Newfoundland was a massive ecological and economic disaster in the early 1990s. For centuries, the Grand Banks were famous for having the most abundant cod population in the world. ______. To prevent total extinction, the Canadian government declared a complete ban on commercial cod fishing in 1992, leaving forty thousand people jobless.
secenekler: Cod is a groundfish that prefers living in cold, deep waters of the North Atlantic Ocean.
However, decades of intensive industrial overfishing with massive trawlers completely depleted the breeding population.
Many fishermen protested against the government regulations, demanding financial compensation.
The Grand Banks of Newfoundland are located where the cold Labrador Current meets the warm Gulf Stream.
Some marine species can recover surprisingly fast once commercial pressure is removed entirely.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde Newfoundland kıyılarındaki morina (cod) balığı bolluğu anlatılmıştır. Boşluğa, "However" (Ancak) geçişiyle devasa trollerle yapılan aşırı avlanmanın (overfishing) üreyen morina nüfusunu tamamen tükettiğini belirten ve devamındaki devlet yasağı (complete ban) kararını gerekçelendiren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Stonehenge, located in Wiltshire, England, is a prehistoric monument that has puzzled archaeologists and historians for centuries. Built over several phases starting around three thousand BC, the giant stone circle required immense physical labor. ______. Specifically, on the longest day of the year, the sun rises precisely over the Heel Stone, shining directly into the center of the monument.
secenekler: The giant sarsen stones were transported from quarries located over twenty miles away.
Many researchers believe that the monument was designed primarily as an astronomical calendar to track seasons.
Stonehenge was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in nineteen eighty-six.
Some modern Druids gather at the monument annually to celebrate the winter solstice.
Archaeological excavations have recently revealed several ancient burial pits near the stones.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede "en uzun günde" (longest day of the year/yaz gündönümü) güneşin anıtın tam merkezine doğduğu açıklanarak astronomik bir hizalamaya değinilmiştir. Boşluğa, anıtın temel olarak mevsimleri takip etmek için astronomik bir takvim (astronomical calendar to track seasons) olarak tasarlandığına inanıldığını belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The eruption of Mount Vesuvius in seventy-nine AD was a catastrophic disaster that completely buried the Roman cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum under thick layers of ash. Thousands of residents were killed instantly by toxic gases and burning volcanic debris. ______. Because the ash sealed the buildings from oxygen and moisture, objects like wooden furniture, bread, and wall paintings remained perfectly intact.
secenekler: Vesuvius is an active stratovolcano located near the modern city of Naples, Italy.
Surprisingly, this destructive event resulted in the most extraordinary archaeological preservation in history.
The eruption was documented in detail by Pliny the Younger in several personal letters.
Pompeii remained completely forgotten and lost under the volcanic soil for over fifteen centuries.
Most tourists visit the archaeological park of Pompeii during the warm summer months.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde Pompei'nin kül tabakası altında kaldığı ve binlerce insanın öldüğü belirtilmiştir. Boşluktan hemen sonra ise "külün binaları oksijen ve nemden koruması sayesinde duvar resimlerinin, mobilyaların kusursuz korunduğu" (perfectly intact) anlatılmıştır. Bu durumu açıklayan; yıkımın tarihteki en olağanüstü arkeolojik korumayla (extraordinary archaeological preservation) sonuçlandığını söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The concept of 'Smart Cities' involves utilizing the Internet of Things (IoT) and advanced data analytics to improve urban efficiency and public services. By installing thousands of sensors across the city, municipal governments can monitor traffic patterns, energy usage, and waste levels in real-time. ______. By optimizing energy grids and reducing traffic congestion, smart cities can dramatically lower their overall carbon footprint.
secenekler: The initial cost of installing smart sensors across an entire megacity is extremely high.
This massive stream of real-time data allows authorities to make highly efficient, automated decisions.
Cybersecurity is a major concern when connecting critical city infrastructure to the internet.
Most citizens are highly worried about the privacy implications of constant digital surveillance.
Singapore is widely considered the world's most advanced and successful smart city model today.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde şehir geneline kurulan binlerce sensörden (sensors) ve gerçek zamanlı veri izlemeden bahsedilmiştir. Boşluğa, "This massive stream of real-time data" (Bu muazzam gerçek zamanlı veri akışı) ifadesiyle başlayan ve yetkililerin otomatik ve verimli kararlar almasını sağladığını belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In psychology, 'imposter syndrome' is a behavioral pattern where individuals doubt their achievements and have a chronic, internalized fear of being exposed as a fraud. Despite objective evidence of their competence, those suffering from it remain convinced that they do not deserve their success. ______. Psychologists suggest that this cognitive distortion is highly common among high-achieving professionals and university students.
secenekler: The syndrome was first identified by clinical psychologists Pauline Clance and Suzanne Imes in 1978.
Instead, they attribute their professional achievements to external factors like good luck or timing.
Many companies are implementing mentorship programs to help employees build self-confidence.
Imposter syndrome is not classified as a mental illness in the official diagnostic manual.
Some individuals experience severe anxiety and depression due to persistent self-doubt.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde imposter sendromu yaşayan kişilerin başarılarına (competence/success) inanmadıkları belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Bunun yerine, başarılarını şans veya zamanlama gibi dış faktörlere bağlarlar" (Instead, they attribute their professional achievements to external factors...) diyen ve "başarıyı hak etmedikleri" inancını tamamlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Tidal power is an highly promising renewable energy source that utilizes the natural rise and fall of ocean tides to generate electricity. Unlike solar and wind energy, which are highly dependent on weather conditions, tides are driven by the gravitational pull of the moon and sun. ______. Although the initial construction costs of tidal barrages are extremely high, they offer a lifespan of over a century.
secenekler: Tidal energy can only be harvested in coastal regions with exceptionally high tidal ranges.
Consequently, this makes tidal energy exceptionally predictable and completely independent of weather shifts.
Some environmentalists are concerned about the impact of tidal turbines on local marine life.
The Rance Tidal Power Station in France was the world's first commercial tidal facility, built in 1966.
Most renewable energy investments are currently focused on expanding onshore wind farms.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde gelgit (tidal) enerjisinin güneş ve rüzgardan farklı olarak hava durumuna bağlı olmadığını, Ay ve Güneş'in yerçekimine dayandığını söylemiştir. Boşluğa, "Consequently" (Sonuç olarak) geçişiyle bu durumun gelgit enerjisini olağanüstü derecede öngörülebilir kıldığını (exceptionally predictable) belirten B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The evolutionary domestication of wild wheat around ten thousand BC was the primary catalyst for the Agricultural Revolution in the Fertile Crescent. Before this transition, early human societies lived as nomadic hunter-gatherers, moving constantly to find food. ______. This permanent settlement allowed for the rise of complex civilizations, writing systems, and urbanization.
secenekler: Wild wheat had brittle stems that shattered easily, making it highly difficult to harvest.
By cultivating wheat in fixed fields, humans could establish permanent villages for the first time.
The Fertile Crescent spans modern-day countries like Iraq, Syria, Jordan, and southeast Turkey.
Agriculture required a massive division of labor, leading to the creation of social hierarchies.
Most early agricultural societies suffered from severe nutritional deficiencies due to single-crop diets.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde tarım devriminden önce insanların göçebe (nomadic) yaşadığı söylenmiştir. Boşluk sonrasında ise "This permanent settlement" (Bu kalıcı yerleşim) denilmiştir. Boşluğa, bu kalıcı yerleşimi başlatan; "buğdayı belirli tarlalarda yetiştirerek insanların ilk kez kalıcı köyler kurmasını sağlayan" B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The rapid rise of micro-mobility—specifically electric scooters and bikes—has fundamentally changed urban transportation in major megacities. By offering a cheap, convenient alternative for short trips, these devices have reduced city car dependency. ______. To address these issues, municipal governments are implementing strict regulations on speed limits and dedicated parking zones.
secenekler: Micro-mobility applications rely on GPS tracking and mobile payment systems to operate.
However, their rapid expansion has created severe safety concerns regarding pedestrian accidents and sidewalk clutter.
Many young professionals prefer using electric scooters because they are highly environmentally friendly.
The cost of renting an electric bike is often comparable to using public bus transit.
Most cities lack the necessary infrastructure, such as protected bike lanes, to support scooters.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede "belediyelerin hız sınırları ve park alanları konusunda katı düzenlemeler (regulations) getirdiği" belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "However" (Ancak) geçişiyle bu hızlı büyümenin yaya kazaları ve kaldırım işgali gibi güvenlik sorunları (safety concerns) yarattığını söyleyerek bu önlemlerin neden alındığını açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Deep-sea gigantism is the evolutionary tendency for marine invertebrates and other deep-water species to grow significantly larger than their shallow-water relatives. Famous examples include the giant squid and the deep-sea giant isopod. ______. At these deep depths, larger bodies are much more energy-efficient, allowing organisms to survive long periods of starvation.
secenekler: The deep ocean is an highly extreme environment with freezing temperatures and high pressure.
Scientists suggest that this phenomenon is primarily an adaptation to scarce food resources.
Giant squids can reach lengths of up to thirteen meters, making them highly elusive predators.
Some deep-sea creatures utilize bioluminescence to communicate or lure prey in absolute darkness.
Most shallow-water invertebrates are restricted in size due to higher water temperatures and competition.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede "derinlerde büyük bedenlerin enerji tasarruflu olduğu ve açlığa karşı dayanıklılık sağladığı" açıklanmıştır. Boşluğa, bu olguyu "kıt yiyecek kaynaklarına (scarce food resources) karşı geliştirilmiş bir adaptasyon" olarak tanımlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: In astrobiology, the 'Goldilocks Zone' refers to the habitable region around a star where temperatures are just right for liquid water to exist on a planet's surface. If a planet is too close to its star, its water will completely evaporate; if it is too far, the water will freeze. ______. Consequently, astronomers focus almost exclusively on this zone when searching for signs of extraterrestrial life.
secenekler: Liquid water is considered the most critical and non-negotiable prerequisite for life as we know it.
Therefore, being in this zone is crucial because liquid water is essential for the chemical reactions of life.
The Kepler Space Telescope has discovered thousands of exoplanets since its launch in 2009.
Mars is located near the outer edge of our solar system's Goldilocks Zone, but its water is frozen.
Some red dwarf stars have very narrow habitable zones because they emit very little heat.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde Goldilocks Bölgesi'nde sıcaklığın "sıvı su" (liquid water) için tam kıvamında olduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Therefore" (Bu nedenle) diyerek yaşam için gerekli kimyasal reaksiyonlar adına sıvı suyun şart olduğunu vurgulayan ve devamındaki "astronomların bu bölgeye odaklandığı" bilgisini gerekçelendiren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The history of the spice trade is a fascinating story of exploration, empire building, and intense economic conflict. In ancient and medieval times, spices like black pepper, cinnamon, and nutmeg were highly valued as luxury commodities across Europe. ______. This powerful economic incentive drove European nations to launch the Age of Discovery, seeking direct sea routes to Asian spice markets.
secenekler: Spices were primarily imported from regions like India, Indonesia, and East Africa via Arab merchants.
Because spices were extremely rare and expensive, controlling the trade routes guaranteed immense wealth.
Nutmeg was once worth more than its weight in gold, highly prized for its medicinal properties.
The Portuguese Empire successfully established a monopoly on the spice trade in the early sixteenth century.
Most modern kitchens contain various cheap spices that were once accessible only to kings.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede "This powerful economic incentive" (Bu güçlü ekonomik teşvik) ifadesi kullanılarak Avrupalıların keşiflere çıkmasındaki maddi kazanç vurgulanmıştır. Boşluğa, "baharatların aşırı nadir ve pahalı olması nedeniyle bu ticaret yollarını kontrol etmenin muazzam bir zenginliği garanti ettiğini" söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The gut-brain axis is a complex bidirectional communication network that connects our gastrointestinal tract with our central nervous system. Scientific research shows that this connection is heavily mediated by the trillions of bacteria living in our gut, known as the microbiome. ______. Consequently, maintaining a healthy gut microbiome through diet can significantly improve mental health and reduce anxiety.
secenekler: Probiotic supplements contain live beneficial bacteria that can temporarily colonize the digestive tract.
Surprisingly, these gut microbes produce over ninety percent of our body's serotonin, a key mood-regulating chemical.
Most scientific studies on the gut-brain axis have been conducted on laboratory mice and rats.
Chronic stress can damage the integrity of the gut lining, leading to severe physical inflammation.
Fermented foods like kimchi, kefir, and yogurt are highly rich in natural beneficial probiotics.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde bağırsak-beyin aksının ve mikrobiyomun (microbiome) öneminden bahsedilmiş, boşluk sonrasında ise "Sonuç olarak, bağırsak sağlığının korunmasının zihinsel sağlığı ve kaygıyı iyileştirebileceği" belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, şaşırtıcı bir şekilde bu bağırsak mikroplarının duygu durumunu düzenleyen serotonin hormonunun yüzde 90'ından fazlasını ürettiğini (produce over ninety percent of... serotonin) söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The Kessler Syndrome is a highly alarming scenario proposed by NASA scientist Donald Kessler in 1978 regarding space pollution. It describes a cascade effect where the density of objects in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) becomes high enough that collisions between debris trigger more collisions. ______. Eventually, this chain reaction could create a permanent belt of hypervelocity space junk, making space exploration completely impossible for centuries.
secenekler: Low Earth Orbit is currently filled with thousands of active communication satellites.
In this scenario, each individual collision generates a massive cloud of tiny, uncontrollable fragments.
Scientific research are currently developing experimental lasers to vaporize small pieces of space junk from Earth.
Sputnik was the first artificial satellite launched into space, marking the beginning of the space age.
Even a paint chip traveling at orbital speeds can damage the International Space Station severely.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde Kessler Sendromu'nun uzay çöplerinin çarpışarak yeni çarpışmaları tetiklediği bir zincirleme etki (cascade effect) olduğu açıklanmıştır. Boşluğa, "In this scenario" (Bu senaryoda) diyerek her bir çarpışmanın kontrol edilemeyen devasa bir parça bulutu oluşturduğunu belirten ve devamındaki zincirleme reaksiyonu (chain reaction) açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Telomeres are protective cap-like structures located at the ends of our chromosomes, often compared to the plastic tips on shoelaces. Their primary function is to prevent DNA from fraying or degrading during cellular division. ______. Once they become too short, the cell can no longer divide, entering a dormant state known as senescence, which drives physical aging.
secenekler: The discovery of telomeres and their protective function was awarded the Nobel Prize in Medicine in 2009.
However, each time a cell divides, these telomeres naturally become slightly shorter.
Telomerase is a specialized enzyme that can rebuild telomeres, but it is highly active in cancer cells.
Healthy lifestyle habits, such as regular exercise and balanced diets, can slow down telomere shortening.
Most chronic diseases, like cardiovascular conditions and diabetes, are linked to cellular aging.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde telomerlerin DNA'yı koruma işlevi (prevent DNA from fraying) anlatılmıştır. Boşluk sonrasında ise "telomerler çok kısaldığında hücrenin artık bölünemediği ve yaşlanmanın başladığı" belirtilmiştir. Bu geçişi "However" (Ancak) diyerek kuran ve hücre her bölündüğünde bu telomerlerin doğal olarak kısaldığını (naturally become slightly shorter) söyleyen B seçeneği akışı tamamlar.

soru_metni: The traditional linear economic model, which follows a 'take-make-waste' pattern, is highly unsustainable in a world with finite natural resources. In response, economists and environmentalists are advocating for a transition to a 'circular economy.' ______. By designing products for durability, reuse, and easy recycling, this model aims to eliminate waste entirely and regenerate natural systems.
secenekler: Plastic pollution in the oceans has increased dramatically due to single-use commercial packaging.
Unlike the linear model, a circular economy focus on keeping resources and materials in use for as long as possible.
The cost of transitioning to a circular system is currently a major barrier for manufacturing corporations.
Many European nations have recently implemented laws requiring companies to take back their electronic waste.
Recycling facilities require highly specialized chemical processes to separate mixed plastic polymers.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde doğrusal (linear) ekonomik modelin yetersizliği belirtilmiş ve döngüsel ekonomi (circular economy) önerilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Doğrusal modelin aksine, döngüsel ekonominin malzemeleri olabildiğince uzun süre kullanımda tutmaya odaklandığını" (keeping resources and materials in use for as long as possible) açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The concept of open-source software relies on decentralized collaboration, allowing anyone to view, modify, and distribute a program's source code freely. Unlike proprietary software developed secretly by corporations, open-source projects thrive on global volunteer contribution. ______. This collaborative model has produced some of the most critical technology infrastructures of the modern world, including the Linux operating system.
secenekler: Microsoft and Apple dominated the personal computer market during the late twentieth century.
By making the code public, developers worldwide can collaborate to fix bugs and add features rapidly.
Some critics argue that open-source software is highly vulnerable to security breaches and hackers.
The Linux operating system was originally created by Finnish computer scientist Linus Torvalds in 1991.
Many software engineers prefer working on open-source projects to build their professional portfolios.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde açık kaynaklı yazılımın (open-source) şeffaf yapısı ve küresel gönüllü katkısı övülmüştür. Boşluğa, "Kodu halka açarak dünyadaki tüm geliştiricilerin hataları hızla düzeltmek ve özellikler eklemek için iş birliği yapabileceğini" söyleyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The invention of the electric telegraph in the nineteenth century was a revolutionary breakthrough that marked the birth of global telecommunications. Before its creation, messages could only travel as fast as physical transport, such as horses or steamships. ______. This instant communication fundamentally transformed international trade, journalism, and military diplomacy almost overnight.
secenekler: Samuel Morse developed the famous Morse code system to transmit letters using electrical clicks.
With the telegraph, information could suddenly travel across continents in a matter of seconds.
The first transatlantic telegraph cable was successfully laid across the ocean floor in 1858.
Most ordinary citizens could not afford to send private telegraph messages because of high costs.
The invention of the telephone by Alexander Graham Bell eventually made the telegraph obsolete.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde telgraftan önce mesajların sadece at veya gemi gibi fiziksel nakliye araçları hızında taşınabildiği belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Telgrafla birlikte bilgi aniden kıtalar arasında saniyeler içinde seyahat edebildi" (information could suddenly travel... in a matter of seconds) açıklamasını getirerek hız karşıtlığını ve anlık iletişimi (instant communication) vurgulayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: CRISPR-Cas9 is a groundbreaking gene-editing technology that allows scientists to make highly precise changes to a cell's DNA sequence. Often described as molecular scissors, it can target specific genes to cut, replace, or repair them. ______. Although the medical potential is immense, the technology has sparked severe ethical debates regarding human embryo editing and designer babies.
secenekler: The technology was developed by scientists Jennifer Doudna and Emmanuelle Charpentier, winning the Nobel Prize in 2020.
Specifically, it offers revolutionary possibilities for curing genetic diseases like sickle cell anemia and cystic fibrosis.
Traditional gene therapy models were highly inefficient and frequently caused dangerous mutations.
Many agricultural companies are utilizing CRISPR to create drought-resistant and insect-proof crops.
The cost of clinical CRISPR therapies is currently extremely high, restricting access to wealthy patients.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde CRISPR-Cas9 teknolojisinin moleküler bir makas gibi genleri tamir edebildiği söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, "Specifically" (Özellikle) diyerek bu sistemin orak hücre anemisi ve kistik fibroz gibi genetik hastalıkları tedavi etmedeki devrimsel olanaklarını (possibilities for curing genetic diseases) açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: While the placebo effect shows how positive expectations can improve a patient's health, its dark counterpart, the 'nocebo effect,' demonstrates the opposite. The nocebo effect occurs when a patient experiences negative physical side effects from an inactive treatment simply because they expect them. ______. This physical response highlight the deep, unconscious power that negative suggestion can have over human physiology.
secenekler: Nocebo side effects can include headaches, nausea, fatigue, and muscle pain.
For example, if a doctor warns a patient that a sugar pill might cause nausea, they often actually vomit.
Clinical trials must carefully document all reported side effects to ensure drug safety.
The placebo and nocebo effects are driven by different neurochemical pathways in the brain.
Most patients are completely unaware that their symptoms are caused by psychological expectations.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde nocebo etkisinin (nocebo effect) hastanın olumsuz beklentiler nedeniyle fiziksel yan etkiler yaşaması durumu olduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, buna somut bir örnek sunarak "Örneğin, bir doktor hastayı bir şeker hapının mide bulantısı yapabileceği konusunda uyarırsa gerçekten kusabilirler" diyen B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Color psychology is an highly influential field utilized by marketing experts to subconsciously affect consumer purchasing decisions. Studies show that different colors can trigger specific emotional states and behavioral responses. ______. In contrast, blue is widely used by corporate banks and tech companies because it evokes a sense of trust, security, and professionalism.
secenekler: The human brain processes visual information, including color, in the primary visual cortex.
For instance, red is often used in retail clearance sales because it stimulates urgency and increases heart rates.
Most fast-food restaurant chains use yellow and red in their logos to encourage appetite and speed.
Some cultures associate white with mourning and death, while others view it as a symbol of purity.
Choosing the right color palette for a brand logo is highly critical for establishing identity.
aciklama: Boşluktan hemen sonra "In contrast, blue..." (Buna karşın mavi...) diyerek kurumsal güven ve profesyonellik hissiyle karşıtlık kurulmuştur. Boşluğa, buna mukabil kırmızı rengin acelecilik hissi uyandırmak (urgency) için indirimlerde kullanılması örneğini veren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The wreck of the RMS Titanic, sitting nearly four thousand meters deep in the North Atlantic, is slowly being consumed by a unique ecological threat. Despite the freezing temperatures and extreme pressure, a specialized species of iron-eating bacteria called Halomonas titanicae has colonized the ship's steel hull. ______. Scientists estimate that these bacteria will completely dissolve the iconic shipwreck within a few decades, leaving behind only rust stains.
secenekler: The Titanic sank in April nineteen twelve after striking an iceberg during its maiden voyage.
These microorganisms feed on the iron in the steel, creating icicle-like rust structures called rusticles.
Marine biologists rely on advanced robotic submersibles to photograph and study the decaying wreck.
The shipwreck was first discovered in nineteen eighty-five by oceanographer Robert Ballard.
Most deep-sea shipwrecks in the Black Sea are preserved perfectly due to lack of oxygen.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde demir yiyen bakterilerin (iron-eating bacteria) geminin çelik gövdesini kapladığı belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Bu mikroorganizmalar çelikteki demirle beslenerek rusticle adı verilen pas yapıları oluşturur" (These microorganisms feed on the iron...) açıklamasını getiren ve çürüme detayını veren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Scientific research shows that taking short daytime naps, often called 'power naps,' can offer extraordinary cognitive and physical benefits. A nap lasting between ten and twenty minutes can instantly boost alertness, improve working memory, and reduce mental fatigue. ______. If a nap lasts too long, the brain enters deep sleep, leading to a groggy, disoriented feeling known as 'sleep inertia' upon waking.
secenekler: Many modern tech companies are installing specialized sleeping pods in offices for employees.
However, keeping these naps short is highly critical to avoid disrupting night sleep.
Napping is highly common in Mediterranean cultures, where it is traditionally known as a siesta.
During deep sleep, the brain consolidates memories and clears out toxic metabolic waste.
Most sleep experts recommend avoiding caffeine after three PM to ensure high-quality night sleep.
aciklama: Boşluk sonrasındaki cümlede "eğer uyku çok uzun sürerse (If a nap lasts too long) beynin derin uykuya daldığı ve uyanınca sersemlik hissi yarattığı" belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Ancak, bu uykuları kısa tutmak gece uykusunun bozulmaması için çok kritiktir" (However, keeping these naps short is highly critical...) diyerek bu uyarıyı hazırlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Soil salinization is a critical agricultural threat that occurs when salt accumulates in the root zone of crops, severely reducing soil fertility. This issue is highly common in arid regions where farmers rely heavily on artificial irrigation. ______. Consequently, as the irrigated water evaporates rapidly under the hot sun, it leaves behind a thick white crust of salt that kills plants.
secenekler: Topsoil contains the highest concentration of organic matter and essential nutrients for crops.
Specifically, irrigation water often contains small amounts of dissolved salts that accumulate over time.
Farmers can reclaim salinized soil by flushing it with massive amounts of fresh water.
The rise of ancient Mesopotamian civilizations was severely disrupted by soil salinization.
Most modern commercial fertilizers contain high amounts of chemical potassium and nitrogen.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde yapay sulama (artificial irrigation) yapılan kurak bölgelerde tuz birikiminden bahsedilmiş, boşluk sonrasında ise "sulama suyu güneş altında hızla buharlaştıkça geride kalın bir tuz tabakası bıraktığı" söylenmiştir. Sulama suyunun zamanla biriken küçük miktarda tuzlar içerdiğini belirten B seçeneği akışı tamamlar.

soru_metni: Aquaponics is an highly innovative, sustainable agricultural technology that combines aquaculture (fish farming) with hydroponics (soil-less plant cultivation) in a closed-loop system. In this integrated setup, fish waste is converted by beneficial bacteria into nutrients for the plants. ______. By recycling water and nutrients continuously, aquaponics uses up to ninety percent less water than traditional soil-based farming.
secenekler: Many urban vertical farms are utilizing aquaponics to grow leafy green vegetables and herbs.
In return, the plants naturally filter and clean the water, which is then pumped back to the fish tanks.
Fish species like tilapia and trout are highly popular in aquaponic systems because of their durability.
The initial cost of installing an aquaponic system is extremely high for small-scale farmers.
Traditional fish farming produces massive amounts of wastewater that can pollute local rivers.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde balık atıklarının bakteriler tarafından bitkiler için besine dönüştürüldüğü söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, "Buna karşılık, bitkiler de suyu doğal olarak filtreleyip temizler ve bu su balık tanklarına geri pompalanır" (In return, the plants naturally filter and clean the water...) diyerek closed-loop (kapalı devre) döngüsünü tamamlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: Prospect Theory, developed by psychologists Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky, is a foundational model of behavioral economics that describes how people make decisions under risk. The theory suggests that individuals evaluate potential losses and gains rather than their final wealth. ______. This psychological bias explains why people are often highly risk-averse when choosing between guaranteed gains but risk-seeking when trying to avoid guaranteed losses.
secenekler: Traditional economic models assume that human beings always make perfectly rational decisions.
Crucially, they discover that people are naturally much more sensitive to losses than to equivalent gains.
The theory was awarded the Nobel Prize in Economics in two thousand two, shortly after Tversky's death.
Loss aversion is a cognitive bias that heavily affects financial investors during stock market crashes.
Most people prefer receiving a guaranteed fifty dollars over a fifty percent chance of winning one hundred.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde Beklenti Kuramı'nın (Prospect Theory) insanların kazanç ve kayıpları nasıl değerlendirdiğini açıkladığı belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Crucially" (Önemli bir şekilde) diyerek "insanların kayıplara karşı aynı miktardaki kazançlara kıyasla çok daha duyarlı olduğunu" belirten ve devamındaki riskten kaçınma (risk-averse) davranışını gerekçelendiren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: While reading, our peripheral vision plays an highly critical role that is often overlooked. Although we can only focus on a few letters at a time with our central foveal vision, our peripheral vision actively previews upcoming words. ______. This cognitive preparation allows the brain to coordinate rapid, smooth eye jumps, significantly increasing reading speed and comprehension.
secenekler: Dyslexic readers frequently struggle with coordinating their eye movements during reading tasks.
Specifically, it identifies the length and boundaries of the next word before the central focus reaches it.
The fovea is the central part of the retina responsible for sharp, detailed visual acuity.
Speed-reading courses often focus on expanding the reader's peripheral visual field.
Most adults can read between two hundred and three hundred words per minute on paper.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde okuma esnasında çevre (peripheral) görüşümüzün bir sonraki kelimeyi önceden incelediği (previews upcoming words) söylenmiştir. Boşluğa, "Specifically" (Özellikle) diyerek çevre görüşün "kelimenin uzunluğunu ve sınırlarını merkez odak oraya ulaşmadan önce belirlediğini" açıklayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The domestication of horses around four thousand BC in the steppes of Central Asia fundamentally changed the course of human history. Before this milestone, humans were restricted to traveling on foot or relying on slow oxen carts. ______. This revolutionary mobility allowed for massive migrations, rapid communication networks, and completely transformed the nature of warfare.
secenekler: Horses were originally hunted for meat before being used as working animals by early nomads.
With horses, humans could suddenly travel vast distances with unprecedented speed and efficiency.
The invention of the wheel in Mesopotamia occurred around the same period, facilitating trade.
Some nomadic tribes in Mongolia still practice traditional horse archery during cultural festivals.
Domesticating large mammals required a deep understanding of animal behavior and breeding cycles.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde atların evcilleştirilmesinden önce insanların yürümeye veya yavaş öküz arabalarına bağımlı olduğu belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Atlar sayesinde, insanlar benzeri görülmemiş bir hızla devasa mesafeleri seyahat edebildiler" (With horses, humans could suddenly travel...) açıklamasını getiren ve devamındaki devrimsel hareketlilik (revolutionary mobility) ifadesini hazırlayan B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: The introduction of the cane toad to Australia in 1935 is a classic example of an highly disastrous biological control intervention. Imported from South America to control the native cane beetle population destroying sugarcane crops, the toads had no natural predators in Australia. ______. Consequently, several native predatory species, such as monitor lizards and quolls, have suffered catastrophic population declines after attempting to eat the toxic toads.
secenekler: Cane toads are highly adaptable and can survive in a wide range of terrestrial habitats.
Furthermore, they possessed highly toxic glands that were lethal to any animal that attacked them.
Australian authorities are currently utilizing biological fencing to stop the spread of the toads.
The cane beetle is a native insect that feeds on the roots and leaves of sugarcane plants.
Most invasive species are introduced accidentally through international cargo shipping vessels.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde Avustralya'ya getirilen dev kurbağaların (cane toad) orada hiçbir doğal avcısı olmadığı belirtilmiştir. Boşluğa, "Furthermore" (Dahası) geçişiyle bu kurbağaların kendilerine saldıran hayvanlar için ölümcül olan son derece zehirli bezleri (highly toxic glands) bulunduğunu söyleyen ve devamındaki yerel yırtıcıların kurbağaları yemeye çalışıp ölmesi sonucunu gerekçelendiren B seçeneği gelmelidir.

soru_metni: As the global transition to solar energy accelerates, recycling retired solar panels is emerging as a major environmental challenge. Most solar panels have an average operational lifespan of about twenty-five years, after which they must be replaced. ______. If these panels end up in ordinary landfills, they can leak toxic heavy metals, such as lead and cadmium, into the surrounding soil and groundwater.
secenekler: Solar panels are constructed primarily of glass, aluminum frames, and silicon wafers.
Consequently, millions of tons of solar waste are expected to accumulate globally by the late 2030s.
Recycling silicon solar panels requires highly complex thermal and chemical extraction processes.
Some countries are offering tax subsidies to encourage companies to develop solar recycling facilities.
Wind turbines face similar recycling challenges regarding their massive composite fiberglass blades.
aciklama: Boşluk öncesinde güneş panellerinin ömrünün 25 yıl olduğu ve değiştirilmesi gerektiği belirtilerek gelecekteki atık sorununa değinilmiştir. Boşluğa, bunun bir sonucu olarak "Consequently" (Sonuç olarak) 2030'ların sonlarında milyonlarca ton güneş paneli atığının birikeceğini söyleyen ve devamındaki çöplüklerde (landfills) oluşturacağı sızıntı tehlikesini gerekçelendiren B seçeneği gelmelidir.
